title: UCO Original Candle Lantern Kit (Various Colours)
descriptionHtml:
The UCO Original Candle Lantern Kit is the classic collapsible aluminium lantern, sold as a complete set with a clip-on side reflector, a neoprene Cocoon case and two emergency candles.

Choose Terra Firma or Glacier. Both have a painted aluminium body and a glass chimney. The lantern collapses to about 11 cm high and 5 cm across, so it packs neatly for a weekend away or an emergency kit at home.

A spring-loaded tube keeps the candle at a steady height as it burns, and the chimney helps the flame cope with a breeze. There is a twist-lock base, a carry handle and a hanging hook. When you are on the move, the neoprene case helps protect the glass, and the reflector clips on to throw light to one side.

The lantern is compatible with UCO candles made for the Original model, including white, beeswax and citronella refills, which we sell separately.

Packed size About 11 cm high x 5 cm diameter (4.25 inches high x 2 inches)
Features Collapsible body, spring-loaded candle tube, twist-lock base, carry handle and hanging hook

What's in the box

  • UCO Original Candle Lantern, in your chosen colour
  • Two emergency candles
  • Clip-on side reflector
  • Neoprene Cocoon case

title: Primus Primetech Stove Set 1x2.3L with pan
descriptionHtml:
A complete Primus camp kitchen for shared meals on the trail.

The Primetech Stove Set 1x2.3L with pan brings the stove, a generous 2.3 litre pot and a frying pan together in one nestable kit. It is a practical choice when you are cooking for family or friends and want a stable, wind-resistant setup without packing a jumble of separate pots and pans.

The remote-canister burner sits low on the foldable heat reflector, which helps keep the whole stove steady. Light it with the independent T-grip Piezo igniter — no matches or lighter required — and the 2000W flame will bring water to the boil in under four minutes. A fine-control regulated valve lets you turn the heat down for a gentler simmer once the pot is bubbling.

The hard-anodised aluminium pot holds 2.3 litres and has an integrated heat exchanger, working with the Laminar Flow Burner and built-in windscreen to make the most of your fuel. When you have boiled water or cooked a stew, the non-stick frying pan doubles as a lid to hold in heat, or comes off so you can fry eggs or pancakes. The removable Crimp Pot Gripper gives you a secure hold on hot cookware.

After supper, wipe the pan clean, nest the pot, pan and stove pieces together and slide the kit into the storage bag. Invented in Sweden and made in Europe. Gas is not included.

What's in the box

  • Laminar Flow Burner with integrated windscreen
  • 2.3L hard-anodised aluminium pot with heat exchanger and non-stick coating
  • Non-stick frying pan that also works as a lid
  • Independent T-grip Piezo igniter
  • Crimp Pot Gripper
  • Foldable heat reflector
  • Storage bag

Gas is not included.

  • Primus Power Gas
  • Primus Long Handle Spoon
  • Primus Essential Stove Set 2.3L

title: Flextail EVO SUP PUMP 200 With Battery - Fast SUP Inflation
descriptionHtml:
Flextail EVO SUP Pump 200 with Battery – 45 PSI Cordless Electric Pump

Inflating a stand-up paddleboard by hand can be one of the least enjoyable parts of getting out on the water. The Flextail EVO SUP Pump 200 removes much of the effort by providing powerful cordless inflation in a compact, portable design.

With a built-in 15,600mAh lithium-ion battery, the EVO SUP Pump 200 can be used without being connected to a vehicle or mains power. It delivers up to 450L/min airflow and can reach pressures of up to 45 PSI, making it suitable for high-pressure SUPs as well as a range of other inflatable equipment.

Fast Dual-Stage Inflation

The EVO SUP Pump 200 uses a dual-pump system to combine high-volume airflow with high-pressure inflation. This allows it to move a large amount of air quickly before switching to higher-pressure inflation as your SUP reaches its required pressure.

Flextail states that the pump can inflate a standard SUP from 0 to 12 PSI in around five minutes, depending on the board and conditions. The automatic inflation system allows you to set the desired pressure and let the pump handle the inflation process rather than manually monitoring the pressure.

45 PSI Maximum Pressure

With a maximum inflation pressure of 45 PSI, the EVO SUP Pump 200 has more than enough pressure capacity for typical inflatable paddleboards. The higher pressure capability also makes it useful for other equipment requiring more than basic low-pressure inflation.

The pump can also be used for kayaks, inflatable boats, wings and other compatible inflatables, making it a useful addition to watersports and outdoor equipment rather than a pump limited to SUP use.

Built-In 15,600mAh Battery

One of the main advantages of the EVO SUP Pump 200 is its integrated 15,600mAh lithium-ion battery. With no external power supply required, you can inflate your equipment at the launch point, campsite, beach or wherever you need it.

Flextail rates the maximum operating time at up to 40 minutes, while a full charge is claimed to provide enough capacity for up to six SUP inflations from 0 to 12 PSI, depending on the conditions and equipment being inflated.

Deflation Function

The EVO SUP Pump 200 isn't just for inflation. It also provides a 5kPa deflation function, allowing air to be removed from compatible inflatables when you're packing away.

Flextail states that the pump can deflate a SUP in approximately 90 seconds, helping to reduce the amount of air left in the board before rolling it up for storage or transport.

More Than Just a SUP Pump

Although designed with SUP users in mind, the EVO SUP Pump 200 can be used with a variety of inflatable equipment. The supplied nozzle system is designed to accommodate different valves and applications, making the pump suitable for SUPs, kayaks, boats, inflatable tents, sleeping equipment and other compatible inflatables.

Its 45 PSI maximum pressure also means it can be used for certain high-pressure applications, while the high-volume airflow is useful for larger low-pressure inflatables.

Compact and Portable

Despite incorporating a large 15,600mAh battery and high-performance pump system, the EVO SUP Pump 200 measures approximately 203 × 182 × 84mm and weighs around 1.2kg with the battery installed.

That makes it considerably more practical to transport than carrying a separate mains-powered pump and external power source, particularly when you're heading to a remote launch point or travelling with your paddleboard.

Flextail EVO SUP Pump 200 Specifications

  • Product: Flextail EVO SUP Pump 200

  • Battery: 15,600mAh lithium-ion

  • Weight with battery: 1.2kg

  • Dimensions: 203 × 182 × 84mm

  • Maximum inflation pressure: 45 PSI

  • Maximum airflow: 450L/min

  • Deflation pressure: 5kPa

  • Maximum running time: Up to 40 minutes

  • Automatic inflation: Yes

  • Battery powered: Yes

  • Suitable for: SUPs, kayaks, boats and other compatible inflatables

A Practical Cordless Pump for SUP Adventures

The Flextail EVO SUP Pump 200 is designed for anyone who would rather spend their time on the water than manually inflating their equipment. Its combination of 450L/min airflow, 45 PSI maximum pressure and a built-in 15,600mAh battery gives it the capacity to handle both fast initial inflation and higher-pressure finishing.

For SUP users, the cordless design is particularly useful when you're away from a vehicle or mains power. title: Flextail ZERO LANTERN - 56g UItralight 2-in-1 Camping Light / Flashlight
descriptionHtml:
Flextail Zero Lantern – Ultralight 2-in-1 Camping Light

The Flextail Zero Lantern is a compact, rechargeable camping light designed for hikers, backpackers and anyone looking to keep their outdoor kit light and practical. Weighing just 56g, it combines a 360° lantern with a focused flashlight, giving you two useful lighting options in one small package.

At only 32 × 69mm, the Zero Lantern takes up very little room in a rucksack, pocket or camping kit. An integrated aluminium carabiner also makes it easy to attach to a pack, tent or other piece of equipment when you need hands-free lighting.

Two Lighting Options in One

The Zero Lantern can be used as both a camping lantern and flashlight. The lantern mode provides 360° illumination, making it suitable for lighting a tent, campsite or table, while the focused flashlight beam is designed for more directional lighting when walking or looking around after dark.

There are four lighting modes available: Camp Light, Flashlight, Ambient and Strobe, giving you flexibility depending on the situation.

The lantern uses a 3000K warm light, while the flashlight uses a cooler 9000K colour temperature. The lantern also offers up to 90 CRI, providing more natural-looking colour rendering.

300 Lumens in a 56g Package

Despite its small size, the Flextail Zero Lantern produces up to 300 lumens. Brightness can be adjusted across four levels, allowing you to choose between a lower output for general campsite use and a brighter setting when more illumination is required.

A metal dimming control provides tactile adjustment, making it easy to change the brightness without having to cycle through multiple settings.

Rechargeable USB-C Battery

The Zero Lantern features a built-in 1100mAh rechargeable battery with USB-C charging. Flextail rates the lantern for up to 35 hours of runtime, depending on the lighting mode and brightness level.

Using a rechargeable battery means there is no need to carry disposable batteries, while the compact design makes the Zero Lantern particularly well suited to lightweight camping and backpacking setups.

Built for Outdoor Use

The Zero Lantern has an IPX5 water-resistance rating and has been tested against drops from up to 1 metre, making it suitable for everyday use outdoors.

A safety lock switch helps prevent the light from being accidentally switched on while packed inside a rucksack or pocket. This is a useful feature when space is limited and you want to avoid arriving at camp with a flat battery.

Flextail Zero Lantern Specifications

  • Weight: 56g

  • Dimensions: 32 × 69mm

  • Maximum output: 300 lumens

  • Battery: 1100mAh / 4.07Wh rechargeable battery

  • Runtime: Up to 35 hours

  • Charging: USB-C

  • Colour temperature: 3000K / 9000K

  • Lantern LED: COB NDF-X20

  • Flashlight LED: LTL4AW LEDs

  • Water resistance: IPX5

  • Lighting modes: Camp Light, Flashlight, Ambient and Strobe

  • CRI: Up to 90

  • Safety lock: Yes

  • Integrated carabiner: Yes

A Practical Light for Lightweight Camping

The Flextail Zero Lantern is aimed at campers who want to reduce the size and weight of their equipment without giving up useful functionality. At just 56g, it can easily be carried as a dedicated camping light, while the built-in flashlight means you don't necessarily need to carry a separate torch.

Whether it is hanging inside your tent, lighting up your cooking area or helping you find your way along a dark trail, the Zero Lantern provides a compact lighting solution for camping, hiking, backpacking and general outdoor use.

title: 3F UL Gear FastSil Pro Silicone Seam Sealer
descriptionHtml:
3F UL Gear FastSil Pro Silicone Seam Sealer

FastSil Pro is a fast-drying silicone for sealing tent seams on sil/sil fabrics. Manufacturer and UK retailers state it dries within about 6 hours, so you spend less time waiting for a tent to air-dry than with slower sealers.

It suits 3F UL Gear Lanshan Pro tents and other brands’ silnylon or silpoly shelters. It can also be used to waterproof some outdoor gear such as gloves and backpacks. Each pack includes one tube and one applicator. See tent spares and Gear Aid Seam Grip + Sil.

What is included

  • 1 tube of silicone sealant
  • 1 applicator

How to use

Pitch the tent taut in a dry, sheltered spot. Make sure the seams are clean and dry, then apply a thin, even layer along the stitching with the applicator. Leave it pitched until fully dry.

Delivery note

Because this is a liquid/gel, most couriers cannot ship it with other products. It is usually sent separately by post, so you may receive more than one package.

title: Toaks Ultralight Titanium 450ml Cup - (Various Colours)
descriptionHtml:
The Toaks Ultralight Titanium 450ml Cup is Toaks' lightest 450ml cup, at just 48g. It's built for gram counters who still want a comfortable drink, packs small, resists rust and won't hold onto flavours.

From morning coffee to a quick trail soup, it's the cup that disappears in your pack and shows up when it matters.

The colour comes from a micro-thin oxide layer grown from the titanium itself. There's no paint or dye to chip or flake, the weight stays the same, it boosts corrosion resistance and stays food-safe with no aftertaste. Colour also makes your cup easy to spot and stops mix-ups in a group.

Ideal for

Ultralight backpacking, thru-hiking, fastpacking and wild camping.

title: Summit To Eat 5 Bean Cassoulet Freeze Dried Camping Meal (Vegan)
descriptionHtml:
This hearty vegan cassoulet is packed with wholesome beans in a tasty garlic and herb sauce, made to keep you at full strength on expeditions and camping trips.

Summit To Eat cook their meals first and then freeze-dry them, which helps them taste better once rehydrated while keeping their nutritional value. Just add hot water and dinner is ready in less than 10 minutes.

Energy 601kcal
Fat 50g (saturates 3.1g)
Carbohydrate 12g (sugars 5.1g)
Fibre 19g
Protein 14g
Salt 2g

Ingredients

Mixed beans (red kidney beans, white kidney beans, butter beans, borlotti beans, chick peas) (62%), diced onions, green beans, diced carrots, rapeseed oil, tomato paste, garlic puree, oregano, cornflour, salt, ground white pepper.

How to use

title: Petromax Charcoal Maker
descriptionHtml:
With the Petromax Charcoal Maker you become your own charcoal burner. This stainless steel canister uses the same principle as a traditional charcoal kiln, low-oxygen combustion or pyrolysis, so you can turn your own chopped wood into hardwood charcoal right in the campfire.

Fill it with fruit wood, birch or beech from the garden, seal the lid and place it in the fire, even while your Dutch oven cooks above it. The charcoal you make has a long glowing time, low smoke and burns hot, and you choose the wood, so you choose the smoke flavour.

Key features

  • Make charcoal from wood you have chopped yourself
  • 10 litre capacity for logs and branches
  • Airtight cover
  • Long burning, high temperature charcoal
  • Low smoke: suits campfires, griddles and fire bowls
  • High quality stainless steel

Specifications

Capacity 10 litres
Dimensions (H x W x D) 23 x 40.2 x 19.8cm
Weight 4.9kg
Packed dimensions 28 x 50.5 x 26.5cm
Packed weight 6.5kg
Material Stainless steel

How to use

Fill the canister with logs or twigs, close the cover and set it in the fire. Within a few hours yellow smoke appears, turning white towards the end. Remove it from the fire, let it cool overnight, and the next morning your charcoal is ready. Clean inside with mild detergent, water and a cloth.

Ideal for

Campfire cooks, bushcrafters and anyone who wants sustainable, home-made charcoal for the Petromax Atago.

Cook alongside it with a Petromax Dutch oven and explore the full Petromax range.

title: Toolkit RC UN3  Lipo Balance lead Charger perfect for HPA batteries (USB-C powered)
descriptionHtml:
The ToolkitRC UN3 is a pocket-sized LiPo balance charger that runs from USB-C, so you can charge at home from a fast phone or laptop charger, or at the site from a power bank. At just 47g it lives happily in your kit bag, and it's a popular choice for small HPA and airsoft LiPo packs.

It charges 2S (7.4v) and 3S (11.1v) LiPos at up to 3A, straight through the battery's balance lead, so you don't need an adaptor for the main plug. Each cell is balanced to within 0.02V, and the LED shows red while it's charging and green when the pack is full.

Your USB-C charger or power bank needs to support fast charging (PD, QC, AFC or SCP) at 9 to 20V. A standard 5V USB port won't power it.

Key specs

  • Brand: ToolkitRC
  • Batteries: LiPo, 2S to 3S
  • Charging: up to 3A, through the balance port
  • Balance accuracy: under 0.02V per cell
  • Input: USB-C, 9 to 20V, up to 25W (PD, QC, AFC, SCP)
  • Size: 85 x 48 x 21mm
  • Weight: 47g
  • LED: red when charging, green when full or on standby

Safety: never leave LiPos charging unattended, and charge them in a LiPo safety bag.

  • Battery checkers and accessories

title: Kombat UK Reusable Hand Warmer Gel Pads – Pair
descriptionHtml:
The Kombat UK Reusable Hand Warmer Gel Pads give you instant warmth at the click of a disc, then reset for use again and again. Each 10cm pad contains sodium acetate, which gives off heat as it crystallises.

How to use

To activate: gently flex (click) the metal disc between your finger and thumb.

To reactivate: place the crystallised pad in boiling water and simmer until all the crystals have dissolved and it turns clear. Let it cool before using again. Do not place it directly on the bottom of a hot pan.

Specifications

Quantity Pair
Diameter 10cm
Active temperature 50–55°C (122–131°F)
Active ingredient Sodium acetate

Safety

Keep out of reach of children. For external use only. The contents may cause harm or irritation if swallowed or if they come into contact with eyes or skin. If a pad is punctured or torn, dispose of it immediately and responsibly.

Prefer something rechargeable? See the Ocoopa UT2s, or grab Thaw disposable hand warmers and more from Kombat UK.

title: Onewind Outdoors Underquilt for Crystal Bridge Hammock
descriptionHtml:
This underquilt is designed specifically for the Onewind Crystal Bridge Hammock, for a perfect fit and full coverage. It creates a draught-free, insulated sleep system that gets rid of cold spots underneath you.

The insulation is bio-based DuPont Sorona synthetic fill. It's high-loft, warm and breathable, for use from about -1°C to 10°C (30°F to 50°F).

A bridge hammock underquilt

  • Custom fit for the Onewind Crystal Bridge Hammock
  • DuPont Sorona synthetic insulation

  • Packs to 18 x 36cm in a double-sided compression sack

  • Windproof and water-resistant
  • 4 carabiners for quick attachment

Why use an underquilt?

In a hammock, your body weight squashes the insulation of a sleeping bag underneath you, so you lose heat into the air below. An underquilt hangs outside the hammock and stays lofted, keeping you warm from below.

Ideal for

Spring, autumn and mild winter hammock camping in the UK.

title: Primus Salt and Pepper Mill 2 Pack
descriptionHtml:
Freshly ground seasoning makes a big difference to a camp meal. This Primus set gives you two lightweight, durable salt and pepper mills that pack away with your cooking gear or sit happily on the kitchen table at home.

They are easy to use with one hand: hold the mill and press the button with your thumb to grind. The two mills come in different colours so you can tell salt from pepper at a glance.

Key features

  • Set of 2 mills
  • 2 colours for quick reference
  • Durable aluminium
  • One-handed use with a thumb button
  • Lightweight and packable

Ideal for

Campsite cooks, campervan kitchens and anyone who likes proper seasoning on the trail, from scrambled eggs to a one-pot stew.

Tips

Keep the mills in a small dry bag with your cooking kit so the salt stays free-flowing in damp weather.

Cook up something worth seasoning on the Primus Essential Trail Kit, compare the GSI Salt and Pepper Grinder, and see more camping utensils.

title: Primus Essential Stove Set 2.3L
descriptionHtml:
All-in-one gas stove for easy cooking in the outdoors

 

Essential Stove Set 2.3L is a practical all-in-one gas stove for hiking and outdoor adventures. Easily cook for up to five people using the two included 2.3L aluminium pots. The stove features a windproof burner and a low centre of gravity for efficient and stable cooking—perfect for boiling water, cooking pasta, or heating soup.

Easy to set up, pack and carry
Essential Stove Set 2.3L is quick to set up. Simply attach the gas canister, ignite the burner, and start cooking. Boil pasta in one pot while heating sauce or soup in the other. Handle hot cookware easily with the included pot gripper, and when you're done, pack everything into the durable storage bag for compact transport.

Compact cooking kit for outdoor meals
Essential Stove Set 2.3L includes everything needed for cooking on the trail. The stove features a windproof burner and Laminar Flow Burner technology for a low and stable centre of gravity. The two 2.3L lightweight aluminium pots are stackable for easy packing. The kit also includes a ceramic non-stick coated lid that doubles as a frying pan, a pot gripper, a foldable heat reflector, and a durable nylon storage bag. Gas is not included—purchase Primus Power Gas, Summer Gas, or Winter Gas separately.

Windproof backpacking stove with a low centre of gravity.
The remote-canister design gives this stove a low and stable centre of gravity, while the Laminar Flow Burner technology ensures additional stability. The windproof burner efficiently boils 1 litre of water in 4.5 minutes, and the flame can be adjusted precisely using the control valve.

Upgrade your Essential stove setup
Essential Stove Set is available in two sizes: 1.3L for 1–3 people and 2.3L for 2–5 people, both including everything needed for simple outdoor cooking. Expand your setup with the Essential Pot Set 2.3L, the LiTech Frying Pan 25cm, or useful accessories such as the Campfire Cutting Set (knife and cutting board) and the Campfire Prep Set.

• Simple all-in-one kit for 2–5 people

• Remote-canister stove for extra stability

• Fuel-efficient

• Windproof burner with Laminar Flow Burner technology

• Two 2.3L anodised aluminium pots

• Lid with ceramic non-stick coating—doubles as a frying pan

• Pot gripper for safe handling of hot cookware

• Foldable heat reflector

• Durable nylon storage bag

• Gas not included—use with Primus Power Gas, Summer Gas, or Winter Gas

title: Primus Mimer Backpacking Stove Duo
descriptionHtml:
A durable gas stove with duo valve and a wide flame—ideal for cooking with larger pots and frying pans for 1–3 people on outdoor adventures.

 

Mimer Stove with duo valve is a robust gas stove that has been a trusted companion on outdoor adventures since the 1980s. With its wide flame and stable design, Mimer is an excellent choice for frying food or preparing larger meals for up to three people. A reliable choice for shorter hikes and camping trips.

Simple, stable, and perfect for frying
Mimer Stove is designed to make outdoor cooking easy. Simply attach it to a gas canister, and it’s ready to use. The stove features four pot supports, providing wind protection and extra stability. The wide flame ensures even heat distribution, making it ideal for frying pans and larger pots. Choose Mimer for cooking sausages, pancakes, or a hearty stew.

Top-mounted backpacking stove for larger pots and frying pans
Mimer Stove includes a top-mounted gas stove in a durable design. It has a 4-point pot support that provides wind protection and stability for larger pots and frying pans (sold separately). Gas is not included—purchase Primus Power Gas, Summer Gas, or Winter Gas separately.

Reliable and long-lasting—generation after generation
Mimer Stove is built to last and has been used worldwide for over 40 years. It features a 4-point pot support that protects the wide flame from wind and delivers 2,800W of power, bringing 1 litre of water to a boil in under four minutes. This model features a Duo valve, allowing compatibility with different gas canister connections.

Accessories to start cooking with your Mimer Stove
Mimer Stove is compatible with larger cookware, such as the PrimeTech Pot Set 2.3L and the LiTech Frying Pan 25cm. Use the PowerLighter for quick ignition in all weather conditions. Take your cooking to the next level by preparing ingredients with the Campfire Cutting Set and Campfire Prep Set.

• Durable gas stove for 1–3 people

• Duo valve

• Top-mounted stove for larger pots

• Wide flame

• 4-point pot support for extra wind protection and stability

• Gas not included—use with Primus Power Gas, Summer Gas, or Winter Gas

descriptionHtml:
The Primus Micron III is an ultralight, foldable, top-mounted gas stove in a pocket-sized format. At just 58g, it is perfect for 1 to 2 people on hikes, climbs and fast weekend trips.

With 2600W of output it boils 1 litre in under four minutes, and its narrow, high-speed flame stays reliable in the wind. An oversized control valve makes it easy to fine-tune the flame.

Key features

  • Weighs only 58g
  • Folds to 62 x 46mm
  • 2600W output: 1 litre in under four minutes
  • Narrow, wind-resistant, high-speed flame
  • Foldable pot supports
  • Oversized, foldable control valve
  • No regulator
  • Nylon storage bag included

How to use

Unfold the stove, screw it onto a gas canister and you are ready to boil water or heat a meal. Pair it with smaller pots for best performance. Use Primus Power Gas, Summer Gas or Winter Gas (not included).

Ideal for

Backpacking, bikepacking and alpine trips where every gram counts.

Fuel it with Primus Power Gas or Winter Gas, and see the Primus Essential Trail Kit and more gas stoves.

title: Flextail Gear Tiny Tire Pump 200 with Bike Tail Light - Up to 130PSI
descriptionHtml:
The Flextail Gear Tiny Tire Pump 200 is a pocket-sized electric bike pump that weighs just 130g but reaches up to 130 PSI. It hits 80 PSI in around 50 seconds, so you can get back on the road quickly after a puncture.

A precision brushless motor and short-stroke, large-bore piston give strong performance with less friction. A centrifugal cooling system moves heat away from the core parts for stable, long-lasting use.

A mini electric bike pump with tail light

  • Just 130g, pocket size
  • Up to 130 PSI
  • 80 PSI in about 50 seconds
  • Large LED display to check tyre pressure
  • Auto shut-off for precise inflation
  • Built-in smart tail light, three modes, up to 12.5 hours
  • Seat tube mount included
  • USB-C charging

Pump and light in one

The Tiny Tire Pump 200 doubles as a rear bike light. Even after 4 to 6 hours of tail light use, it only uses about half the battery, leaving enough to deal with a flat. The included adapter mounts it on your seat tube, so it doesn't take up space in your bag.

Specifications

Size 52 x 29 x 67 mm
Weight 130 g
Max pressure 130 PSI (896 kPa)
Charging USB-C

Ideal for

Road cycling, gravel riding, commuting and bikepacking, wherever you want a light, quick puncture backup.

Compare the Flextail Tiny Bike Pump Pro. Inflating a SUP? See the Flextail EVO SUP Pump Pro. Browse our pumps and inflation and the full Flextail range.

title: Flextail Gear Tiny Shower Bucket or Tiny Shower Bag
descriptionHtml:
The Flextail Gear Tiny Shower Bucket and Tiny Shower Bag are 20 litre portable shower kits with a built-in electric pump and shower head. There are no extra parts or awkward hoses: just fill it, press one button and get a steady, powerful stream.

The palm-sized pump uses Flextail's MicroTurbo tech, and gives up to 70 minutes of runtime on a single USB-C charge, enough for five 14-minute showers.

A rechargeable portable camping shower

  • 20L (5 gallon) sealed reservoir
  • Built-in electric pump and shower head
  • Up to 70 minutes per charge
  • USB-C fast charging
  • Two pump-pressure settings
  • Fine 0.6mm shower head holes for pressure with less water
  • Aerated shower head and faucet
  • Hang from a tree or vehicle, or stand on its flat base
  • Choice of bucket or bag

One kit, lots of uses

Shower after a swim, wash your hands, rinse fruit and veg, clean paddleboards, bathe the dog, hose down bikes or give your car a quick rinse.

How to use it

Fill the reservoir, hang it from a branch, a vehicle or a rock, or stand it on its base. Fit the pump and press for an instant shower or tap. Use the lower setting to make your 20 litres last longer.

Ideal for

Camping, campervans, off-roading, surfing, wild swimming and beach days.

Want something smaller? See the Flextail Tiny Shower or Flextail MAX Shower. Browse our camping comforts and the full Flextail range.

title: Flextail EVO SUP Pump Pro 45 PSI (8000mAh)
descriptionHtml:
The EVO SUP Pump Pro is a battery-powered pump that takes the hard work out of inflating a paddleboard. Clip it on, choose the mode and let it do the rest, while you get changed or wax your board.

It works in two stages: high flow at 360 litres a minute to fill the board fast, then high pressure up to 45 PSI to firm it up. Flextail says it reaches 15 PSI on a SUP in about 9.5 minutes, and the built-in 8,000 mAh battery can inflate several boards before it needs charging. Set your pressure on the display and it switches off automatically when it gets there. It also deflates, which makes packing up much quicker.

Key features

  • Six preset modes, including SUP, car tyres and air tents
  • Real-time pressure display in PSI, bar or kPa
  • Auto shut-off at your chosen pressure
  • Active cooling so it can run for long periods
  • Works as a power bank to charge your phone
  • 8 nozzles, to fit most inflatable paddleboard brands

Specifications

Maximum pressure 45 PSI (3.1 bar)
Flow rate Up to 360 L/min
Battery 8,000 mAh
Running time Up to 45 minutes
Weight 1.7 kg
Size 28.1 x 24.7 x 10.2 cm

Need something smaller for mats and camping kit? The Flextail Max Pump 3 is pocket-sized. See all our air pumps or the full Flextail range.

descriptionHtml:
The Flextail Gear Tiny Sleeping Pad R03 is a lightweight, 3-season inflatable sleeping mat with an R-value of 3.5. This is the Large version, at 196cm long and 65cm wide, giving taller campers room to stretch out.

It weighs just 603g including the pump, so it's light enough for backpacking but warm enough for spring, summer and autumn nights.

What does R-value 3.5 mean?

R-value measures how well a mat insulates you from the cold ground. The higher the number, the warmer it is. An R-value of 3.5 suits 3-season camping in the UK. For winter, pair it with a foam mat underneath or choose a higher-rated pad.

Ideal for

title: Bushcraft Essentials Wood Slide for Bushbox XXL+
descriptionHtml:
The Wood Slide for the Bushbox XXL+ feeds firewood into the fire chamber for you. Load longer branches at the start and they slide in as the fire burns, so you can cook or relax instead of constantly adding fuel.

How to use

Slide it in through the fuel window at a slight angle, then set it horizontal. Adjust the angle with the attached chain by hooking it into the two outermost hooks at the top. For longer, heavier branches, use a steeper angle (a shorter chain) so the wood slides reliably and the stove stays stable.

Light your Bushbox as usual, then add wood via the slide. You may occasionally need to nudge the wood in so it burns evenly.

More ways to use it

  • At a shallow angle, a small platform to keep a drink warm
  • Hooked vertically inside to close the fuel window for a campfire
  • For cooking with charcoal
  • As an extra windshield for a Trangia

Specifications

Fits Bushbox XXL+
Size 15.5 x 15cm
Weight 184g
Material 100% stainless steel
Made in Germany

Safety

The chain withstands high temperatures but never touch it with bare hands when hot. Always wear gloves.

See the Bushbox XL stove, the Bushbox case and the full Bushcraft Essentials range.

descriptionHtml:
The Petzl Duo S is a waterproof, rechargeable head torch built for caving and other wet, dark places. It puts out up to 1,100 lumens in BOOST mode and runs on a removable 3200mAh lithium-ion battery.

Easy to use in gloves. A large rotary switch selects the mode and locks, so it can't switch on in your bag. A gauge shows the battery level, and when it runs low, a 20-lumen reserve mode gives you another 45 minutes.

Ideal for caving, climbing, night work and emergency kits.

title: Onewind Outdoors Crystal Bridge Hammock
descriptionHtml:
Say goodbye to the banana bend. The Onewind Crystal Bridge Hammock has a flat-lay bridge design, with wide shoulders (42") and tapered feet (29") for full-body support, so you can lie flat, sleep on your side or stretch out in comfort.

The bed is ultralight, tear-resistant 20D monofilament nylon. It's semi-transparent and silky smooth, for better airflow and a view of the sky above.

Why 4-strap suspension?

Instead of one strap at each end, Onewind uses two per side. This forms longer, flatter suspension triangles that increase sideways stability, reduce the risk of rolling and spread your weight evenly. That matters most on a bridge hammock.

Hammock bed, removable bug net, four tree straps, two spreader bars, cinch buckles and stuff sacks. Hang the bug net from tree limbs or a tarp ridgeline.

Ideal for

Hammock camping, backpacking, wild camping, side sleepers and anyone who finds gathered-end hammocks uncomfortable.

title: Petromax Adhesive Pad for 25L Cooler Box
descriptionHtml:
With the Adhesive Pad you not only effectively protect your Cooler Box kx25 from scratches and bumps but at the same time ensure for more grip. The thin cover made of synthetic foam is made custom-fit for the surface of the ultra-passive cooling systems kx25. The dense material creates a durable protective layer defying wind and weather. Thus, you and your Cooler Box profit from the special protection against moisture, UV- radiation and temperature effects. Even if you have been in outdoor action up to the knee: Rough dirt can be removed easily by brushing or wiping off. In just a few steps the anti-slip pad is applied and directly provides you with more support during your very own adventures.

The lashing points have been omitted within the pad; thus, you can still secure your ultra-passive cooling system before transport. The extra layer is available in two colours and in two designs each. You alone decide what your next nature experience looks like.

Non-slip stand or comfortable seat? Both, because with functional Petromax accessories you stay flexible. The installed Adhesive Pad can be used in combination with the Seat Cushion for the Petromax Cooler Box kx25 and provides you with the necessary freedom.

How to apply the Adhesive Pad the right way

  1. Before application, make sure that the surface of the lid is free of dirt by cleaning it thoroughly with water and a customary dishwashing detergent. Afterwards, dry with a cloth.
  2. Remove the adhesive film on the back and hold the Adhesive Pad just over the lid of the Cooler Box and align by centre.
  3. When the position is correct start on one side of the lid and apply the edge of the Adhesive Pad flush. Do not press down yet, otherwise you cannot correct the position anymore! Now let the rest of the adhesive area follow slowly, until it rests completely on the Cooler Box.
  4. As soon as the edges lay exact you can press down the Adhesive Pad firmly with the palms of your hands.

Material: Synthetic foam
Dimensions: (H x W x D): 0.3 x 55 x 37.5 cm
Weight packed: 380 g

title: Kombat Rubber Mallet
descriptionHtml:
Pushing pegs in by hand only works on soft ground. The Kombat Rubber Mallet gives you the extra force to drive tent pegs into firm, dry or stony ground, and the rubber head is kinder to pegs than a metal hammer.

When it's time to pack up, use the built-in tent peg extractor to hook stubborn pegs out of the ground, so you don't bend pegs or hurt your fingers pulling them by hand.

Tips for using a tent mallet

Drive pegs in at about 45 degrees, leaning away from the tent, so the guyline pulls against the angle. Tap gently at first to start the peg, then strike harder once it's set. Use the extractor to lever pegs straight out rather than twisting them.

descriptionHtml:
The Silva Expedition S is a high-performing mirror sighting compass for experienced users and professionals. It is built for accuracy, precision and durability when the terrain demands it.

The mirror lets you see the compass dial and your landmark at the same time, for accurate bearings over long distances in open terrain.

title: Silva TYP 1933 Compass
descriptionHtml:
Compass Typ 1933 is a traditional baseplate compass inspired by the classic Silva compasses from the 1930s, 1940s, and 1950s. It features modern features such as a global compass needle, a built-in magnifying lens, and a grip-friendly compass ring in durable CNC aluminum. The Compass Typ 1933 is delivered in retro packaging.

Inspired by older Silva compass models
In 1933, The Kjellström brothers along with Gunnar Tillander, invented the first Silva compass. To honor them, we designed the Compass Typ 1933, inspired by Silva's older compass models from the 1930s, 1940s, and 1950s. The compass features a detachable red cord and comes in a gray felt case in retro packaging with Silva's early logo.

Retro compass with modern features
Type 1933 has a retro look with modern features such as a global compass needle, a grip-friendly compass ring in durable CNC aluminum with rotatable compass housing, a built-in magnifying lens, and luminous markings for night navigation. It includes map-measuring scales of 1:50,000 and 1:25,000 in millimeters and inches, making it compatible with most maps. Compass Typ 1933 is made of durable material that withstands challenging weather conditions.

title: Primus Toaster
descriptionHtml:
Fresh toast at camp is one of life’s small luxuries, and the Primus Toaster makes it easy. This lightweight, durable toaster sits on almost any camp stove, so you can brown your morning bread before topping it with avocado, butter or jam.

The stainless steel frame holds a mesh net top that spreads heat across the bread for an even golden finish. When breakfast is done, collapse the frame and fold the handle down, and it slips into your cooking box.

Key features

  • Works on almost any camp stove
  • Stainless steel frame
  • Mesh net top distributes heat evenly
  • Collapsible frame with fold-down handle
  • Lightweight and durable

How to use

Unfold the frame and handle, set the toaster over a low to medium flame and lay your bread on the mesh. Turn the slice once the underside is browned.

Tips

Watch it closely, as toast browns quickly over a stove. Let the frame cool before folding it away.

Ideal for

Family camping, campervan trips and relaxed weekend breakfasts outdoors.

Use it on the Primus Micron III stove with Primus Power Gas, and see more camping stove accessories.

title: Primus OmniFuel incl. Fuel bottle & Pouch
descriptionHtml:
Award-winning and reliable multifuel stove for 1–4 people – fuel bottle and super pouch included. Built to withstand extreme expeditions, high altitudes, cold, and strong winds.

 

A stove with precise flame control, extremely high heat output, Fuel Bottle and a super pouch provides a complete kit for your travels.

The OmniFuel is Primus most award-winning stove to date. This extremely robust, reliable, and powerful stove is designed to handle demanding situations, extreme altitudes, both low and high temperatures, and can be easily carried to any destination.

Adjustable to work with a multitude of different liquid fuel types, including gas, gasoline/petrol, diesel, kerosene/paraffin and even aviation fuel. The OmniFuel delivers 3000W and can boil a liter of water in just over three minutes, while the oversized control knob offers precise flame control, from a fine simmer to quickly melting endless amounts of snow to hydrate an expedition.

The OmniFuel is the perfect stove for 1-4 people who want to travel light. Comes with a fuel bottle (with an ErgoPump™), a multi-tool with a cleaning needle, a foldable windscreen, a heat reflector, and a super pouch.

Accessories that maximise performance
Enhance your OmniFuel stove with the PrimeTech Pot Set 1.3L and the PowerLighter, which works in all weather conditions.

title: Primus OmniLite Ti (Titanium) Including bottle
descriptionHtml:
This ultra-light, titanium, multi fuel stove has incredible flame control and uses multiple fuel options so you can cook anywhere in the world.

The OmniLite Ti is our lightest multi fuel stove, and is based on the same technology as our award-winning OmniFuel Stove. This stove is designed to handle the most demanding situations and environments, while being able to travel the globe.

Adapted to work with the latest generation of fuel-efficient Primus PrimeTech pots with integrated heat exchangers, the OmniLite puts out 8900 BTU (2600W) and can boil a litre of water in under four minutes. Adjust the power of the flame with the oversized control knob, from a fine simmer to quickly melting endless amounts of snow to hydrate an expedition.

The OmniLite is the perfect stove for 1-2 people who want to travel ultra-light, yet need the option to use different types of fuel (gas, gasoline/petrol, diesel, kerosene/paraffin and even aviation fuel). OmniLite Ti comes with an ErgoPump, a multi-tool with a cleaning needle, a foldable windscreen, a heat reflector, and a nylon bag to fit it all.

Can be combined with OmniLite TI Silencer for a quieter cooking experience.

• Lightweight and packs down for ultimate travel experience

• Ultralight, titanium pot supports

• Fuel-efficient burner; most efficient with Primus PrimeTech Pot with integrated heat exchanger

• Fine control valve for precise flame and heat control

• Travel friendly, works with variety of fuel types including canister gas, white gas, kerosene, diesel and aviation fuel

• Multiple jet nipples included to use with corresponding fuel

• Comes with an ErgoPump, a multi-tool with a cleaning needle, a foldable windscreen, a heat reflector and a nylon bag

A folding 4-leg design handles large pots and bigger groups, and a preheating coil keeps it working in the cold season. It puts out 2700W and boils a litre of water in under 4 minutes.

A stable remote canister camping stove

Multi-fuel option

Set the stove on stable, level ground, never use it inside a closed tent, and let it cool before packing.

Ideal for

Group cooking, expeditions, winter camping and large pots.

Fuel it with Primus Power Gas or Primus Winter Gas, and browse gas stoves.

title: Primus Primetech Stove Set 2x1.3L with pan
descriptionHtml:
All-in-one cooking kit made to feed the family and friends on outdoor adventures.

The Primetech stove system is a unique multi-person all-in-one system for the backpacking family. This system offers the most stable and windproof burner and contains the stove, 2 pots and a pan to cook for the crew.

Set up your backcountry kitchen with ease. The remote-canister stove, placed on the foldable heat reflector, stands alone with a low center of gravity and can be lit with the independent t-grip Piezo igniter. Boil water for your coffee and oatmeal with the 2000W flame in under four minutes, then fry up your morning eggs in the frying pan/lid that has a non-stick PTFE-coating. Easily switch between handing the hot pots with the Pot Gripper.

When you are ready to break down camp, simply wipe out the pan‚ the non-stick coating is super easy to clean‚ and then nest all of the pots, pans and pieces into each other. Slide into the storage bag for a clean, compact, and rattle-free camp kitchen.

PrimeTech advanced technology improves heat-efficiency by combining an optimized burner, an integrated windscreen, and a pot with an integrated heat exchange. This reduces fuel consumption by almost 50% (compared to conventional stoves), meaning you get to carry less fuel‚ hence a lighter backpack and more environmentally friendly cooking.

The stove system comes with an integrated Laminar Flow Burner and windscreen, two pots, a frying pan lid, an independent t-grip Piezo igniter, a Crimp Pot Gripper, a padded/insulated storage bag and a foldable heat reflector.

 

• Fuel-efficient, all-in-one stove system with integrated Laminar Flow Burner Technology‚ and windscreen

• Remote-canister stove offers max stability due to lower center of gravity

• Fine control valve for precise flame and heat control and regulated valve

• Two lightweight hard-anodized aluminum pots -one with integrated heat exchanger and ceramic, non-stick coating - nest into each other for easy packing

• Frying pan/pot lid with non-stick ceramic-coating works as a skillet or keeps heat in while boiling water

• Remote, independent t-grip Piezo igniter included, no lighter required

• Removable Crimp Pot Gripper handles hot pots and pans with ease

• Regulated valve for precise flame and heat control and fuel efficient cooking

• Invented in Sweden, made in Europe

• Gas NOT included

Use Primus Power Gas, Summer Gas or Winter Gas, sold separately. Choose Primus Winter Gas for cold conditions.

Use on firm, level ground in a well-ventilated area, and never inside a closed tent.

Ideal for

Backpacking with friends, family camping, Duke of Edinburgh groups and campsite cooking.

title: Primus Lite Plus Stove System
descriptionHtml:
Compact, lightweight and fuel efficient top-mounted kitchen solution for 1-2 people, for all of your cycle packing needs.

 

Compact, lightweight and fuel efficient top-mounted kitchen solution for 1-2 people, for all of your cycle packing needs.

This compact and lightweight backpacking stove system can feed 1-2 and offers the most efficient heating in an easy to use and easy to pack footprint. Attach and lock the 0.5L pot to the burner with a simple twist. The Piezo igniter lights the stove with a push of a button so you can boil water quickly.

The Laminar Flow Burner is extremely compact, and puts out a 4500BTU (1500 W) flame, boiling 0.5L water in less than three minutes in a quieter cooking experience. Simply pour directly from the pot spout or use the included pots support pegs for use with ANY pot or pans. If you are just hanging around, you can unbuckle the handle and pair with the included suspension kit while waiting out the weather in a portaledge.

Easily pack the stove attached to a 100g gas canister into the hard-anodized aluminum pot that has a cork insulated sleeve made of G-1000 Eco Lite fabric for burn free handling. Store the cloth with burner and gas canister in the pot to avoid parts rattling during gravel rides.

Combined with our Coffee-Tea Press for a quick coffee break while on the trail (not included).

Compact and Lightweight

Designed specifically for cycle packing, this stove system is ideal for 1-2 people, offering a compact and lightweight solution that doesn’t compromise on performance.

Powerful and Efficient

The Laminar Flow Burner provides a 4500BTU (1500W) flame, delivering efficient heating while maintaining a quieter cooking experience. The pot spout or included support pegs allow for versatile use with any pot or pan.

Tie a ridgeline between two trees and attach the pull-outs either side of the zip to it with prusik knots and small karabiners. Hang a sturdy stick over the ridgeline and hook the zip pull-out and the opposite pull-out onto it, then adjust the top and peg out the four bottom pull-outs.

title: Flamers KindleFlamer Natural Firelighter (3 Pack)
descriptionHtml:
KindleFlamers are all-in-one natural firelighters that remove the need for kindling. At around 17cm long, one KindleFlamer and a few smaller logs are all you need to light a log fire.

On a charcoal barbecue, one KindleFlamer lights a much larger area than two or three standard Flamers, and it works well in a chimney starter too. No newspaper, lighter fluid or paraffin firelighters needed.

Key features

  • Pack of 3, each approx. 17cm long
  • Replaces kindling
  • Lights quickly, even when wet, when used with Ready to Burn wood
  • Untreated wood shavings dipped in refined paraffin wax
  • Clean burn with minimal smoke and no unpleasant smell
  • Made in Britain

Ideal for

Log burners, open fires, campfires, charcoal barbecues and pizza ovens.

How to use

Lay one KindleFlamer in the grate with smaller logs over it, light the end and let it catch before adding larger wood. For charcoal, place it in the chimney starter or under a pile of coals.

For smaller fires try Flamers Natural Firelighters 24 pack, and see more fire lighting equipment and the Flamers range.

title: BE Bushbox Wood Slide for LF and XL
descriptionHtml:
The Bushbox Wood Slide makes cooking on your Bushbox easier and more relaxing. It feeds firewood into the fire chamber automatically, so there's no need to keep adding fuel. Just feed in longer branches from the start and focus on cooking or enjoying the fire.

It fits the Bushbox LF and Bushbox XL.

An automatic wood feeder for the Bushbox

  • Fits Bushbox LF and Bushbox XL
  • Feeds longer branches as they burn
  • Adjustable angle with the attached chain
  • Steeper angle for longer, heavier branches
  • Doubles as a platform to keep a drink warm

How to use it

Insert the Wood Slide through the fuel window at a slight angle, then set it level. Hook the chain into the Universal Grate groove on both sides to set the angle. Light your fire as normal, then add wood through the slide. As the fire burns, the wood slides in by itself. For longer and heavier branches, use a steeper angle (shorter chain) to keep the Bushbox stable.

Meanwhile, cook on the Bushbox using the trivets or Universal Grate.

Ideal for

Longer cooking sessions, slow simmering and relaxing evenings round a small fire.

Use it with the Bushbox XL or Bushbox LF Set. Browse the full Bushcraft Essentials range and our solid fuel stoves.

Ticks are a growing problem in the UK countryside, and removing them quickly and cleanly matters. The BCB Anti-Tick Pick kit has specially designed tweezers for the quick and hygienic removal of ticks from either you or your pet.

Everything comes in a handy, durable nylon pouch with a belt loop, so you can carry it on walks, in the car or in a first aid kit.

What’s in the kit

  • Tweezers
  • Alcohol-free cleansing wipes x 4
  • Adhesive dressings x 10
  • Nylon pouch with belt loop

Specifications

Pouch size 15cm x 9cm x 3cm
Pouch material Nylon

Ideal for

Dog walkers, hikers, deer stalkers and families who spend time in long grass, woodland or moorland.

Tips

Check yourself, children and pets after every walk. Clean the area with a wipe after removal and cover it with a dressing if needed.

Prevent bites with insect repellent, see the Lifesystems tick remover card, and browse first aid kits.

title: BCB Fireball Flint & Striker - Mini
descriptionHtml:
The BCB Fireball Flint and Striker Mini is an effective alternative to matches, and it adds a liquid-filled compass for emergency navigation too.

The compact flint is designed for continual use, and its sparks burn hotter and longer. The sturdy metal striker is a separate hardened hacksaw blade, whose teeth give a large striking surface.

Key features

  • Compact flint for continual use
  • Sparks burn hotter and longer
  • Separate hardened hacksaw blade striker with a serrated edge
  • Liquid-filled compass for emergency navigation
  • Small enough for any emergency or survival kit

How to use

Prepare a small pile of dry tinder. Hold the flint close to it and scrape the striker firmly down the flint so the sparks land in the tinder, then gently blow the ember into flame.

Ideal for

Hikers, walkers and anyone building an emergency or survival kit who wants a compact backup to matches.

title: O Light i3T 2 EOS Small EDC Torch
descriptionHtml:
The O Light i3T 2 EOS is a small EDC (everyday carry) torch. Its compact size means it can live in a pocket, a bag or a car glovebox, so you always have a reliable light with you when you need it.

Why carry an EDC torch?

A phone torch drains your battery and is awkward to hold steady. A dedicated small torch is quicker to reach for and keeps your phone free for maps and calls.

Ideal for

  • Finding your way back to the tent after dark
  • Searching a rucksack or car boot
  • Dog walks and evening commutes
  • Power cuts at home
  • Keeping in a first aid or emergency kit

Tips

Keep the torch in the same pocket or pouch every day so you can find it by feel in the dark, and check it before each trip.

See the O Light Oclip clip light, more camping torches and the O Light range.

descriptionHtml:

title: Firemaple Petrel G3 Ultralight Cooking system with Stove with  Hornet ii stove
descriptionHtml:
Ultralight Fire Maple Cooking Stove

  • High-efficiency cooking system with titanium gas burner
  • 600ml aluminium pot
  • 2500w titanium gas burner
  • Boils water in approximately 95 seconds
  • Insulated handle cover to prevent burns
  • Lightweight at only 250g
  • FREE DELIVERY & SAME-DAY DISPATCH AVAILABLE


Camp cooking doesn’t get much more convenient than when you’re using the Petrel G3 Fire Maple Cooking System. 

The Petrel G3 is a powerhouse when it comes to cooking performance. Its efficient titanium gas burner has a heat output of 2500w, boiling water in just 95 seconds! No more waiting around for your meals to cook, you can be enjoying your food in no time.

It also features a heat exchanger on the bottom, which maximises fuel efficiency by capturing and transferring heat more effectively, ultimately using less fuel. 

The Petrel’s 600ml capacity pot is versatile enough for cooking a range of meals, from soups and dehydrated stews to brewing up a much-needed cup of coffee.

The nifty transparent lid allows you to monitor your camping meals while they cook, and the insulated handle cover ensures that you won't burn yourself when handling the pot. But for potential burns, always have a first-aid kit on hand.

The pot itself is made from aluminium, keeping the weight to an incredible 162g, making it perfect for backpacking and camping trips where every gram counts. 

All the additional accessories* with the cooking system fit neatly inside the pot, too, saving space and making it easy to transport.


Specifications

Materials

Burner: Titanium

Pot: Aluminium
Power 2500 W
Dimensions 10.9 x 10.9 x 11.4 cm
Set Weight 250g (total)


Contents

  • 1 x Titanium Gas Burner, (2500w) Hornet II
  • 1 x Aluminium 600ml Pot
  • 1 x Mesh Transport Bag


FAQs

How Long Does the Fire Maple Cooking Stove Take to Boil Water?

The Fire Maple cooking stove boils 600ml of water in approximately 1 minute and 35 seconds, thanks to its efficient 2500w titanium gas burner and heat exchanger, ensuring fast cooking performance even in outdoor environments.

What Fuel Can Be Used With the Fire Maple Cooking Stove?

The Fire Maple cooking stove is compatible with standard butane or propane gas canisters, which are widely available at outdoor or camping stores or online from JustSupplies.

Please note that gas isn’t included as standard and must be purchased separately.

Why is Titanium Good for the Fire Maple Stove?

Titanium is perfect for the Fire Maple stove because it's lightweight, strong, and can handle high temperatures. This makes it durable and efficient without adding extra weight to your gear, ideal for backpacking and camping adventures.

title: Firemaple Mars Radiant Stove System with Cup
descriptionHtml:
The Mars is Fire Maple's stove system for mountains, winter camping and bad weather. Instead of an open flame, it uses a radiant burner with a pressure regulator. The flame is fully enclosed inside the heat exchanger, so wind barely touches it and almost all of the heat goes into your pot.

In Fire Maple's lab, it boiled 0.5 litres in 1 minute 40 seconds using just 5.2g of gas, and a full litre in about 3 minutes 20 seconds. The gas canister connects on a separate hose, which keeps the stove low and stable and the valve away from the burner. It's also noticeably quieter than a standard roaring stove. An extra pot support lets you use other pots and pans.

Specifications

Power 2,100 W
Pot capacity 1.25 litres
Boil time 1 min 40 sec per 0.5L, about 3 min 20 sec per 1L (Fire Maple lab tests)
Gas use 5.2 g per 0.5L boiled
Weight About 733 g
Folded size 12.8 x 13.7 x 19.3 cm
Design Remote canister, pressure regulator, radiant burner

Pair it with a 230g gas canister, or see all camping gas canisters. For a lighter all-rounder, look at the Fixed Star X2. Browse the full Fire Maple range.

title: Petromax Chef's Knife 20cm
descriptionHtml:
This high-quality Petromax chef's knife has been meticulously handcrafted in Solingen and is an indispensable tool for cutting fruit, vegetables, meat and fish.

The Petromax chef's knives are unique and indispensable companions in any outdoor kitchen. Each knife has an individual oxide coating that not only gives it a special look, but also makes each knife unique. The hand-hardened and hand-ground blades guarantee exceptional sharpness, durability and robustness.

In addition to their tried and tested chef's knife with a generous blade length of 17cm and a material thickness of 3mm, Petromax also offer a chef's knife with a 20cm long blade and a slimmer thickness of 2mm. The longer blade enables effortless cutting of juicy meat and tender vegetables such as asparagus. The ergonomic walnut handle ensures a comfortable grip, while the full-length steel and riveted handle guarantee stability. These knives were developed in close cooperation with outdoor chefs and manufactured in Solingen, the city of blades. This city with its long tradition and craftsmanship expertise stands for quality and is characterised by high edge retention and first-class workmanship.

If the knife is very dirty, you can clean it by hand with a little washing-up liquid without bringing the handle into contact with water. However, simple cleaning with water is normally sufficient. After cleaning, you should dry the knife carefully.

With a Petromax chef's knife in your hand, the whole world of cooking is open to you. Whether meat, vegetables, fruit or herbs - you can cut everything. Even difficult foods that break easily, such as asparagus, Parmesan cheese or cauliflower, can be cut effortlessly.

Features:

  • Made in Germany: handmade in the blade city of Solingen
  • Each piece is unique due to individual oxide coating
  • Sharp blade due to the knife being sharpened by hand
  • Stainless steel and handle made of walnut wood
  • In Petromax design: lettering and dragon logo

descriptionHtml:

Hammock camping, tarp shelters, bushcraft camps and quick rain shelters on day hikes.

title: Toaks Titanium Wood Burning Stove ( Small  /  Large)
descriptionHtml:
The Toaks Titanium Wood Burning Stove lets you cook on twigs and sticks instead of carrying gas. The original Toaks wood stove (STV-11) won an award at Outdoor Friedrichshafen in 2015 for its efficiency, light weight and how easily it lights.

The stove is just three stacking pieces of titanium that lock together. A system of vents burns not only the wood, but also the wood gas inside the stove, with secondary and tertiary combustion. That means it gets more heat from less wood, burns cleaner and starts more easily.

Choose your size

Size Weight Packed Assembled Packing
Small 151 g 94 x 94 mm 94 x 183 mm Nests in the TOAKS 750ml pot
Large 225 g 105 x 105 mm 105 x 205 mm Packs into the TOAKS 1100ml or 1600ml pot

The small stove is 20% smaller than the large but burns the same clean flame. Each stove comes with a durable nylon stuff sack.

Why you'll like it

  • Titanium, light and strong
  • Wood gasification for a hotter, cleaner burn
  • Three pieces that lock together
  • Packs inside a Toaks pot
  • No fuel to carry
  • Nylon stuff sack included

Ideal for

Bushcraft, ultralight backpacking, wild camping where fires are permitted, and as a back-up when your gas runs out. Always use it on a non-flammable surface and follow local fire rules.

Pack it with the TOAKS 750ml pot or the Toaks 1100ml pot with pan. Get it going with a Fire Maple Fire Starter. Browse our solid fuel and wood stoves and the full Toaks range.

descriptionHtml:

title: Light My Fire MayaSticks 450g
descriptionHtml:
MayaSticks from Light My Fire are natural fire starters cut from resin-rich Pinus montezumae, ethically sourced in Honduras. The high natural resin content gives a hot, slow-burning flame that catches easily, even when the sticks are wet.

They come in a paper bag that can go straight on the fire, and they smell great as they burn. Each refill supports a business that plants two trees for every stump harvested, creates local jobs and education, and makes use of leftover stumps that would otherwise go to waste.

Key features

  • 100% natural, resin-soaked fire starters
  • Water-resistant and easy to light
  • Hot, slow-burning flame
  • 16 to 18 sticks per 450g (1lb) bag
  • Burnable paper packaging
  • Made in Honduras

Ideal for

Lighting campfires, barbecues, grills and wood burners at home, and keeping a reliable tinder supply in your camping kit.

How to use

Shave a few curls from a stick or light one end directly, then build small kindling around the flame before adding larger wood.

Pair them with the Light My Fire FireLighting Kit or the GrandPa’s FireGrill, and see more fire making equipment.

title: Petromax Carving Knife 24cm
descriptionHtml:
Whether meat, fish or fruit, with the Petromax carving knife you can cut thin or thicker slices - just as you need it. Its tapered design enables precise cuts without unnecessary pressure.

This carving knife is aimed at fire cooks who demand the highest standards. The individual oxide coating makes each knife unique, which not only impresses visually, but also ensures durability. The blade has been hardened and sharpened by hand, making it exceptionally sharp, robust and durable.

The handle of the Petromax carving knife is made of fine walnut wood and fits perfectly in the hand. The full-length steel and the riveted handle guarantee safe and comfortable handling. This knife was designed with the needs of outdoor chefs in mind. It was produced with care in Solingen, a city with a centuries-old tradition in the manufacture of swords, knives and scissors.

Gentle cleaning with a little washing-up liquid is sufficient if the blade is very dirty. However, simple cleaning with water is normally sufficient. The handle should not come into contact with water. After cleaning, it is important to dry the knife thoroughly to preserve its quality and sharpness.

Features:

  • Made in Germany: handmade in the blade city of Solingen
  • Each piece is unique due to individual oxide coating
  • Sharp blade due to the knife being sharpened by hand
  • Stainless steel and handle made of walnut wood
  • In Petromax design: lettering and dragon logo

title: Petromax Nata Knife 20cm
descriptionHtml:
Made in Finland with German steel, the Petromax Nata Knife combines German quality and Finnish craftsmanship.

The blade of the Nata knife is made of premium German carbon steel (also known as 80CrV2). It can withstand impacts and heavy loads, making it an ideal garden tool as well as a survival knife. title: DD Hammock Underblanket XL - Olive Green
descriptionHtml:
The DD Underblanket XL is a longer version of DD's time-tested underblanket, made for larger hammocks, fuller coverage and taller campers. It's suitable for temperatures down to -5°C.

Hang it under your hammock and feel the warmth build in minutes.

How does a hammock underblanket work?

In a hammock, most heat is lost from below, because your body weight squashes your clothing or the loft in your sleeping bag. An underblanket hangs beneath the hammock so its loft isn't compressed, creating a pocket of air warmed by your body. Hang it with a little slack so it gently hugs the hammock when you're inside.

Which hammocks does it fit?

Ideal for

Winter and shoulder-season hammock camping, bushcraft and anyone who sleeps cold.

title: Stormsure Tuff Tape (Various Sizes)
descriptionHtml:
Stormsure Tuff Tape is a strong, clear, self-adhesive repair tape supplied as pre-cut patches and strips in various shapes and sizes. It is made from a thin but very tough polyurethane film with a pressure-sensitive adhesive and backing paper.

Key features

  • Waterproof and airtight
  • Highly resistant to abrasion, tearing and punctures
  • Stretchy and elastic, so it can bind items tightly together

Ideal for

Quick repairs to rips in waterproof clothing, netting and fabrics, inflatable mattresses, canoes and RIBs, tents and awnings, sails, kites, waders, and cracked buckets and plastic containers.

How to use

Make sure the surface is clean and dry. Cut a piece to size with good scissors or a sharp scalpel, peel off the backing paper and position it over the damage. Press it down from one edge to avoid trapping air bubbles, then rub firmly with something smooth and hard, such as the back of a spoon, for maximum adhesion.

title: Stormsure Water Sports Repair Kit
descriptionHtml:
Glue for repairing all types of water sports equipment and clothing

This very special adhesive glue is one of the few products that can repair leaks, cracks and rips on water sport inflatables, equipment, canoes, sailing, boats, swimming, diving, kayaks, and clothing and many more!
Repairs are permanent, strong, waterproof, flexible and resistant to abrasion (weather and water abrasion).

A perfect way to get you back into the water safely, Stormsure glue is the perfect solution. You can plug the hole or patch the tear with this excellent product.

Stormsure Flexible Repair Adhesive is a very strong general purpose adhesive and it can also be used as a surface sealant. It exhibits special characteristics unlike many adhesives as it is highly flexible and stretchy after it has cured but it remains very strong. It fills gaps well, it is suitable for use indoors and outdoors and in marine environments. The adhesive can be painted on top of a surface to make it waterproof, airtight or abrasion resistant. Stormsure adhesive can often be used to cover holes without a patch. A thick film of adhesive will make a good repair. If the glue will drip through the hole just place some sticky tape behind the hole before applying the glue. It can be removed once the glue has cured.

Stormsure Flexible Repair Adhesive bonds to virtually all surfaces including neoprene, rubber, leather, PVC, polyurethane, breathable and coated fabrics, wood, metal and more. It is ideal for repairing cracks in rubber wellington boots, hiking boots, loose soles, leaks in waders, rips in wetsuits, damaged horse rugs, holes in tents and canopies, leaks and splits inflatable items and many other items too. It can also be used for repairs to woodwork and furniture, roof tiles and concrete. 
A tube of Stormsure Flexible Repair Adhesive is an essential part of a repair kit for hikers, DIY, fishermen, equestrians, hunters, divers, campers, surfers, sailors, engineers etc!
Comes with disposable gloves.

DIRECTIONS:
Use the adhesive at room temperature. Clean the damaged area to remove dirt and grease (sandpaper the surface for best adhesion). Apply a generous amount of Stormsure Flexible Repair Adhesive to the damaged area, with at least a 5mm extra around the damaged area. Leave horizontal and allow to cure for 24 hours.
TIPS:
Mix with Stormcure Accelerator to reduce cure time to approximately 1 hour. Ensure there is no air left in the tube before replacing cap.
Store partly-used tubes in a deep freezer.

title: Stormsure Flexible Repair Adhesive  (Clear/ Black)
descriptionHtml:
Stormsure Flexible Repair Adhesive is a one-part polyurethane adhesive for repairs that need very high durability, strength and flexibility. Use it to join two surfaces, or spread it over one surface as a sealant.

It reacts with moisture in the air to cure, giving a strong, waterproof bond that works indoors, outdoors and even under water.

What can it bond?

Wood, concrete, stone, metals, laminate, most plastics, glass, PU, leather, tile, rubber, PVC and most flexible natural and man-made fabrics, on themselves or in combination. Ideal for inflatables, waterproof gear, tents and models.

Key features

  • Flexible, strong and waterproof
  • Bonds to virtually all surfaces
  • Fills gaps and holes
  • Full cure in 24 hours
  • Resistant from -30°C to +80°C
  • Available in clear or black

How to use

Make sure surfaces are clean and free of dust and grease. Apply glue to one surface, assemble immediately, press firmly and hold still for at least 10 to 12 hours. Use at room temperature (15 to 25°C) and not below 5°C. Test on an inconspicuous area of fabric first.

Tip

Store part-used tubes in a freezer, then warm to room temperature before re-use. If it looks white and waxy, it is too cold: warm it until liquid again.

Patch with Stormsure Tuff Tape, see the Universal Repair Kit and the full Stormsure range.

title: Aquatabs Water Purification Tablets (50)
descriptionHtml:
Aquatabs are tablets you add to drinking water to kill most harmful micro-organisms. Each tablet dissolves clear within minutes and disinfects the water within 30 minutes.

What Aquatabs remove

  • 99.9999% of bacteria
  • 99.99% of viruses
  • 99.9% of cysts (Giardia)
  • Within 30 minutes, in non-turbid water

Specifications

Pack 50 tablets
Tablet size 8.5mg
Shelf life 5 years in strips of 10, 3 years in tubs

How to use Aquatabs

  1. Use clear water. If it is murky, filter it through a cloth first.
  2. Dissolve the tablet in the volume of water shown on the dosage chart. Use the high-risk dose unless the water is from a known source.
  3. Shake or mix to disperse.
  4. Wait 30 minutes, then the water is safe to drink.

Do not swallow the tablet.

Ideal for

Hiking, travel, survival kits, emergency kits and expeditions.

Pair them with a LifeStraw Peak filter, add them to a BCB Combat Survival Tin, and browse water filters and purification.

title: Petzl SWIFT RL 1200 Lumen Rechargeable Head Torch
descriptionHtml:
The SWIFT RL is Petzl's most powerful compact head torch: 1,200 lumens from a lamp that weighs just 92 g. It is a favourite with fell runners, ski tourers and anyone moving fast in the dark.

Its Reactive Lighting mode uses a light sensor to adjust the brightness and beam to what you are looking at. You get the light you need without thinking about it, and the battery lasts much longer. At medium brightness in Reactive mode it runs for at least 7 hours. Double-tap the side for a 6-second BOOST when you need to check the route ahead. The beam reaches up to 168 metres.

The split headband holds steady when you run, the comfort foam comes out to save weight, and a reflective cord helps you stay visible. The 2,250 mAh battery charges by USB-C in about 5 hours, and Petzl rates the lamp IPX4 weather-resistant.

Specifications

Brightness 1,200 lumens (ANSI FL1)
Weight 92 g
Beam distance Up to 168 m
Battery R2250 lithium-ion 2,250 mAh, USB-C
Charge time About 5 hours
Water resistance IPX4
Guarantee Lamp 5 years; battery 2 years or 300 charges

Need a spare? The Petzl R2250 rechargeable battery is made for this lamp. Want something simpler? Try the Petzl Actik Core. Mount it with the Helmet Adapt. Browse head torches.

  • Petzl Actik Core 625 Lumen Head Torch
  • Petzl R2250 Battery
  • Petzl Tikka 350 Lumen Headlamp
  • Petzl Swift LT 380 Lumen Head Torch

After cleaning your Dutch oven, rest the spacers on the rim and set the lid on top so there is a gap for air to flow.

title: Heat2Eat Replacement Heat Stones
descriptionHtml:
Heat2Eat Replacement HeatStones let you keep using your Heat2Eat Self-Steamer for hot food without a stove or flame. Just add water and the HeatStone does the work.

Which size do I need?

HeatStone Compatible with
80g HeatStone Full range of Heat2Eat small Self-Steamers
100g HeatStone Full range of Heat2Eat medium Self-Steamers

How to use

  • Only use in a ventilated area
  • Pour tap or spring water up to the line inside the container
  • Put your food in the heating tray (add water to dried food, or follow the food pack instructions)
  • With dry hands, take the HeatStone out of its plastic packet and lay it in the bottom of the container
  • Place the food tray in the container and fit the lid firmly
  • Do not touch the container or cover the vent hole while it steams
  • After 15 to 30 minutes, carefully remove the lid and eat from the tray

Disposal

Once it is cold, put the used HeatStone in general waste.

Ideal for

Emergency food kits, festivals, fishing trips and anywhere a stove is not practical.

title: Petromax 27L Cooler Backpack - Olive
descriptionHtml:
The Petromax Cooler Backpack 12 litres keeps your food and drinks fresh for up to 8 days on the road, thanks to the electricity-free cooling using ice cubes. With the Cooler Backpack, which has a capacity of 15 kg or 27 l, you are completely independent outdoors and can take care of yourself since you do not rely on electricity.

The comfortable back padding, chest strap and individually adjustable shoulder straps make it convenient to carry wherever your journey takes you. Thanks to the carrying handle and the two handles on the side, you can always keep the Cooler Backpack straight and can immediately take an iced drink by opening the waterproof zipper. The Cooler Backpack is perfectly protected against the leakage of melted water, because the water-repellent nylon fabric combined with the dirt-repellent surfaces let you always transport your provisions undamaged. After a long journey, you can simply open the well-deserved cool beer with the bottle opener.

You can transport smaller or larger accessories on the carabiners. You can attach other items with the help of the elastic straps. In the large front pocket and the two side pockets as well as in the two mesh pockets, you will find space for fire-making accessories, such as the Fire Kit or the fire piston. In addition, you also take tableware and camping cutlery in the backpack and are well equipped for an evening at the campfire.

Even after 8 days on the road, you can still measure 8°C in the interior compartment of the Cooler Backpack. With the conventional refrigerator temperature you enjoy absolute independence. The backpack can hold 13 x 1-litre bottles of beverage upright and in addition to a pack of ice cubes, a 0.33 l or 0.55 l six-pack of beer, your grilled food will also fit in the backpack.

The Cooler Backpack 27 litres is the ideal companion for over 6 days of independent cooling and the perfect equipment to take comfortably to your next adventure.

Features:

  • 8 days electricity-free cooling with ice cubes
  • Water-repellent nylon fabric, waterproof zipper and dirt-repellent surfaces provide long lasting durability
  • Comfortable carrying thanks to back padding and individually adjustable chest strap and shoulder straps
  • Large front pocket (waterproof), 2 large side pockets (waterproof), 2 mesh pockets, loops and elastic bands for hanging accessories
  • Bottle opener for instant drink enjoyment

Technical Details:

Colour: Olive
Material: Insulating foam, nylon, TPU coated
Exterior dimensions incl. front pocket (approx.) (H x W x D): 54.5 x 44.5 x 34 cm
Interior dimensions (approx.): 43 x 31 x 21 cm
Dimensions with packaging (approx.): 54.5 x 44.5 x 34 cm
Weight with packaging (approx.):  3 kg
Weight (approx.): 3 kg
Capacity (max.):  15 kg/ 27 l
Capacity PET bottles: 13 x bottles 1 l horizontal
6-pack beer: 1 x 0.33 l or 0.5 l

The Petromax Camping Oven brings fresh veggie bakes, breakfast rolls and cakes wherever you are. Heat from a gas table, camping stove or embers rises from the base into the ring mould, and the closed lid spreads it evenly for proper top and bottom heat.

Ventilation openings and the outer coating give excellent air circulation and reliable baking results. The stainless steel knob lets you check your food safely, and two handles let you serve straight from the ring.

A portable stovetop oven for camping

  • Three-part design for top and bottom heat
  • Works on gas and electric cookers, camper hobs and campfires
  • Use over embers with the Cooking Stand
  • Central opening for even cooking
  • Stainless steel lid knob
  • Two serving handles
  • 2L capacity

Specifications

Material Stainless steel
Dimensions (H x W x D) 14.3 x 41 x 31.6cm
Capacity 2L
Weight 1.64kg

How to use it

Set the base on your stove, add the ring mould with your food and close the lid. Use a medium flame and check with the knob until golden.

Ideal for

Vanlife, campervans, caravans and campsite baking.

Use it over embers with the Petromax Steel Cooking Stand, and browse camping pots and pans and the full Petromax range.

title: Bushmen HIDEOUT Thermo - Camo Bivvy Bag / Tarp / Poncho
descriptionHtml:
The Bushmen HIDEOUT Thermo Camo is a multifunction bivvy bag that protects you against cold, wet and insects. It also works as a rain poncho, hammock sock and tarp.

A zip-in hood gives an overall length of 2.6m (2.3m tarp plus 0.3m hood), so even tall people have room in the foot to keep boots dry. Two internal pockets with waterproof zips hold a phone, headlamp or maps.

A 4-in-1 bivvy, tarp, poncho and hammock sock

  • Internal heat-reflecting THERMO layer
  • Reflects 98% of UV, UPF50+
  • Mosquito net hood
  • 2.6m overall length with hood
  • 90cm wide at shoulders, 55cm then 45cm at feet
  • 2 internal waterproof-zip pockets
  • Join two to make a 2-person bivvy
  • Expanders included for hammock sock use
  • Repair patch included

As a rain poncho

Waterproof double-sided side zips keep out heavy rain, snow and wind better than snaps or Velcro, and let you adjust breathability. Long flaps reach below the knees, and the chest has a waterproof zipped pocket and patch panel.

Safety and care

The fabric is not flame or spark resistant, so keep it away from fire. The expander hooks act as fuses: if a cord slips out, the load is too high. Some condensation inside is normal with heavy use.

Ideal for

Bushcraft, stealth camping, hammock camping and emergency shelter.

See the insulated Bushmen HIDEOUT Warm, add a Bushmen THERMO-Tarp, and browse the full Bushmen range.

descriptionHtml:

The hood has a built-in mosquito net against mosquitoes, ticks and other insects. At 90cm wide at the top, tapering to 45cm at the feet, it is roomy enough for broad shoulders.

A 4-in-1 bivvy bag, sleeping bag and poncho

Tips

The plastic hooks on the expanders act as fuses. If a cord slips out, the load is too high, so ease off before reattaching it. Some condensation inside is normal with heavy use.

Ideal for

Bushcraft, hammock camping, wild camping and lightweight emergency shelter.
