title: Opinel No 8 Black Oak Knife
descriptionHtml:
The Opinel No 8 Black Oak is the black edition of the iconic Opinel knife. The blade and safety ring are given a PVD coating, which improves corrosion resistance and is safe for food contact. The varnished handle is oak from French forests.

It offers excellent cutting quality, and the Virobloc safety ring lets you work without risk. A striking design and a memorable gift.

Specifications

Blade length 8.5cm
Steel Martensitic stainless steel, 55-57 HRC
Finish Matt black PVD coating
Handle Varnished French oak
Lock Virobloc safety ring

The matt black blade

The black blade is more resistant to rust than a classic stainless blade, but more sensitive to scratching. Avoid abrasive products or scouring sponges when cleaning it.

Care tips

Wipe it clean and dry after use, and avoid long contact with acids, salt water or detergent.

Over 18s only. We will not sell knives to anyone under 18. Under UK law it is illegal to carry a lock knife, a fixed-blade knife, or a folding knife with a blade over 3 inches in public without good reason.

Ideal for

Gifts, picnics, camp kitchens and collectors.

See the Opinel No 8 Olive Wood or the Opinel No 8 Stainless with Sheath, and browse the full Opinel range.

descriptionHtml:

Size guide

The Revolution has a modern oversized fit, and sizing is based on your height. Please check the size guide before ordering.

Ideal for

Wild swimming, open water swimming, SUP and surfing, rainy dog walks, winter hiking and watching outdoor sports.

Prefer a classic robe? See the RED Original Change Robe. Browse our dry robes and changing robes and outdoor jackets.

Smart design meets peak performance. We developed our innovative, new Contour™ reservoir to be lightweight, low profile and rugged. A 3D bottom, Shape-Loc™ baffles and side exit port combine to provide superior fit and performance in the widest variety of packs for extended backpacking and hiking adventures.

  • GRAB HANDLE: Soft touch flexible handle simplifies filling & carrying.

  • REVERSIBLE: Use the internal drying tab to reverse the reservoir for deep cleaning and complete drying.
  • Included magnet clip attaches to reservoir tube and can be paired with your pack of choice for easy access
  • Plug-N-Play® connect system lets you easily disconnect the drink tube from the reservoir for easy filling

  • DIMENSIONS: 429 mm x 190 mm / 16.9 in x 7.5 in
  • WEIGHT: 155 g / 5.5 oz
  • MATERIAL: TPU, ABS, POM, PP, EPDM, Silicone, 304SS, TPU Coated Nylon Fabric

title: Hydrapak Contour 1.5L Lumbar Bladder
descriptionHtml:
The HydraPak Contour Lumbar is a slim 1.5 litre reservoir made for waist and hip packs. It is light and rugged, and its Shape-Loc baffles keep the profile low and stop water sloshing about on steep, rough trails.

Key features

  • Universal hanger works with clips, hooks and loops in many packs
  • Comet bite valve, self-sealing and one-handed to open and lock
  • Soft, flexible grab handle for filling and carrying
  • Reversible for deep cleaning and drying, with internal drying tab
  • Magnet clip to keep the tube to hand
  • Plug-N-Play quick-disconnect tube
  • Abrasion resistant TPU with RF welded seams
  • 100% BPA and PVC free, can be frozen

Specifications

Capacity 1.5L / 50 fl oz
Weight 128g / 4.5oz
Dimensions 224 x 283mm
Max temperature 60°C / 140°F
Materials TPU, ABS, POM, PP, EPDM, silicone, 304SS, TPU coated nylon

Ideal for

Mountain biking, trail running and short rides or race days where a waist pack replaces a full backpack.

Care

Turn the reservoir inside out using the drying tab after each use so it dries fully.

For bigger packs see the Contour 3L or Velocity bladder, and browse the HydraPak range.

A boat-shaped hammock with bug net

Fit the straps around two trees, clip on the karabiners and hang the hammock. Insert the arches to raise the net, then peg out the side points if needed.

Ideal for

Summer camping, bug-free lounging, festivals and garden sleepovers.

Add a DD Tarp 3x3 for rain cover, and browse camping hammocks and the full Naturehike range.

title: Optimus Gas Canister 4 Season Black 230g
descriptionHtml:
Optimus 4-Season Gas keeps your stove running smoothly all year round. Its high-quality mix contains an increased amount of isobutane, which has a particularly low boiling point.

That means the same stable performance near freezing and at high altitude that you expect in milder conditions.

A cold weather gas canister for camping stoves

  • 230g canister
  • 70% isobutane, 25% propane, 5% butane
  • Stable performance near freezing
  • Suited to high altitude
  • For year-round use

Cold weather tips

Keep the canister warm in your sleeping bag or jacket before cooking on cold mornings, and shelter the stove from the wind to save fuel.

Gas safety

Extremely flammable. Store away from heat and direct sunlight, and never use a stove inside a closed tent.

Ideal for

Winter camping, mountain trips, shoulder-season backpacking and year-round stove use.

Also available: Optimus 100g, Optimus 230g and Optimus 450g gas. Browse camping gas canisters and the full Optimus range.

title: Opinel No 8 Olive Wood with Sheath
descriptionHtml:
The Opinel No 8 Olive Wood brings the classic Savoyard folding knife to the Mediterranean, with a handle in beautifully grained olive wood. It comes with an Alpine sheath in a wooden pencil-box case with a clear cover, so it makes a lovely gift.

Specifications

Blade length 8.5cm
Blade steel Martensitic stainless steel
Hardness 55-57 HRC
Blade shape Yatagan, convex ground
Handle Olive wood
Lock Virobloc safety ring
Included Alpine sheath and wooden gift box

The Opinel stainless blade

Opinel's stainless steel is chosen for corrosion resistance and strength. It holds a sharp edge, resists wear and needs no special care in everyday use, though long contact with acid, salt water or detergent should be avoided.

The Virobloc safety ring

Invented by Marcel Opinel in 1955, the Virobloc ring locks the blade open for safe use, and locks it closed for safe carrying.

Care tips

Wipe the blade dry after use and give the olive wood handle an occasional rub of oil to keep it looking its best.

Over 18s only. We will not sell knives to anyone under 18. Under UK law it is illegal to carry a lock knife, a fixed-blade knife, or a folding knife with a blade over 3 inches in public without good reason.

Ideal for

Gifts, picnics, camp kitchens, whittling and collectors.

Prefer the classic version? See the Opinel No 8 Stainless Steel with Sheath. Keep it sharp with the Opinel maintenance kit, and browse the full Opinel range.

title: Opinel Maintenance Oil
descriptionHtml:
Look after your Opinel with Opinel’s own maintenance oil. It greases the blade and ferrule to keep them working smoothly, and nourishes wooden handles. It can also be used to care for wooden cutting boards.

Key features

  • Greases blades and ferrules
  • Nourishes wooden knife handles
  • Also suitable for wooden cutting boards
  • Easy to use with a cloth

How to use

Clean the knife and dry it with a soft, dry cloth. Put a few drops of oil on a cloth and rub it over the blade and ferrule. Wait until the blade is dry before closing the knife.

For the handle, apply a few drops of oil to a cloth and grease it evenly all over.

Ideal for

Owners of Opinel folding knives, especially wooden-handled models used outdoors, and anyone caring for wooden boards and utensils.

title: Naturehike Cloud Peak 2-Man Tent (Green) T DOOR (Limited Run)
descriptionHtml:
Limited Run of the popular T Door Version we are unsure if these will be back any time soon.

Why Choose The Cloud Peak Tent?

Enjoy the great outdoors with Cloud-Peak, a freestanding tent for camping that is lightweight and easy to set up. Boasting optimal stability, comfort and weight, this two-person shelter is easy to pitch so that all your alfresco adventures - including auto-camping or high-altitude treks – are stress-free!

Key Features

  • LIGHTWEIGHT AND COMPACTABLE: Naturehike’s Cloud-Peak backpacking tent offers the most spacious and comfortable accommodations in an ultra-lightweight design. It is a must-own outdoor gear for every minimalist backpacker.
  • HIGH-QUALITY WATERPROOF MATERIAL: The tent fly comprises 20D double-line nylon plaid fabric with a waterproof index of PU4000mm. The inner tent is made of 20D Silicone Nylon Plaid. The net yarn is made of B3 fine polyester breathable mesh. The bottom tent is made of 20D silicone nylon plaid, and the tent pole is made of 7001 aluminium alloy poles.
  • THOUGHTFUL DESIGN: The Cloud-Peak tent’s dome shape with multiple poles provides an excellent snow load handling capability. The all-season tent wall can be extended to the ground and mesh area and backed with an adjustable fabric panel. The dual entrance with a single vestibule configuration allows quick access and provides extra storage space. The add-on footprint efficiently covers the entire tent; It can be attached to the tent even when pitching.

 

Naturehike is a popular brand with an eye for detail, and this tent is no exception. With two entry points for easy access, as well as a full mesh roof that allows stargazing on those clear summer nights, you’ll always have the perfect camping spot set up.

Tent Specifications

Model: NH17K240-Y
Colour: Army green
Material:

Tent fly: 20D double-line nylon plaid fabric

Waterproof: PU coating waterproof 4000mm

Inner tent: 20D Silicone Nylon Plaid  (T Door)

Net yarn: B3 fine polyester breathable mesh

Bottom tent: 20D Silicone Nylon Plaid

Tent pole: 7001 aluminium alloy pole
Storage Size: About 915x50cm
Weight: About 2.5kg

FAQs

Is the tent waterproof?

Yes, this tent is made with a special waterproof PU coating rated 4000mm to keep you dry through any weather. The inner tent also features the same waterproof coating.

What are the dimensions of the tent?

Once erected, the tent has a width of 210cm, length of 210cm and height of 105cm. A small packdown size of 50cm x 15cm makes it incredibly portable.

How much does the tent weigh?

The Naturehike Cloud Peak tent weighs just 5.5lb (2.4kg)!

How should I store my tent?

Avoid packing away your tent if it is still damp or dirty. While we use the highest quality waterproofing, long-term exposure to moisture can start the process of hydrolysis - causing a sticky and non-waterproof coating on your tent materials. Just 24 hours in warm weather could be enough for mildew to begin forming, damaging its appearance and smell and likely voiding the warranty.

descriptionHtml:
USB Rechargeable Hand Warmer & Power Bank Gadget

  • Dual-purpose rechargeable hand warmer/power bank

  • 3 versatile heat setting options
  • Super compact design to fit in pockets
  • Usage time of up to 13 hours
  • FREE UK DELIVERY & SAME-DAY DISPATCH AVAILABLE

 

 

The THAW Rechargeable Hand Warmers are a must-have for winter outdoor adventures!

With double-sided heat output, both of your hands can stay toasty at once, no matter how cold the weather gets outside! With a maximum heat of 59⁰C for the small hand warmers and 57⁰C for the large ones, you can choose from 3 different heat settings depending on how chilly it is.

The smart power control feature allows you to seamlessly switch between power modes – it’ll help protect your hands from sudden weather changes and save energy, too.

With the memory recall feature, this hand warmer remembers your last settings, so it gives you instant warmth or power just like you used it last time. Super convenient when the temperature drops!

When you don't need the heat setting, you can switch to the power bank mode to easily recharge your devices on the go! Power bank mode is displayed with blue lights instead of red, so you know when it's in use.

While you’re at it, check out the rest of our THAW gear!

57⁰C maximum

Contents

  • 1 x USB-C Charging Cable
  • 1 x User Manual

FAQs

How Long Does a Single Thaw Hand Warmer Charge Last?

A single Thaw Hand Warmer charge can last between 5 to 13.5 hours, depending on the model size and heat setting. Use the low setting for longer warmth or switch to power bank mode to maximise battery life during use.

How Many Charges Does the Thaw Hand Warmer Power Bank Give?

Each full charge of the Thaw Hand Warmer power bank allows you to recharge most smartphones up to two times or top up smaller devices like earbuds multiple times, enabling you to stay connected without running out of battery on your adventures.

Should I Choose the Small or Large THAW Hand Warmers?

This all depends on how much power you want the device to have and the size of your hands.

The small THAW Hand Warmer is a more compact size with a slightly lower battery life than the large version. It does, however, produce a higher maximum heat (59⁰C compared to 57⁰C of the large ones).

On the other hand, the large THAW Hand Warmer has a larger battery capacity and life, making it perfect for longer trips or colder weather.

How Long Will It Take for My THAW Hand Warmers to Be Delivered?

We can deliver your THAW gadget in as little as 1 to 2 working days! Place your order before 12 p.m. Monday to Friday for same-day dispatch, and refer to our Delivery Policy for full details.

Can I Collect the Rechargeable Hand Warmers?

You can! You can order online and collect your hand warmers from a UPS Access Point® near you. Simply select Click & Collect at checkout and choose your preferred location.

What it removes

  • 99.999999% of bacteria
  • 99.999% of parasites
  • 99.999% of microplastics
  • Silt, sand and cloudiness
  • Activated carbon reduces chlorine, organic chemical matter and odours

It meets US EPA and NSF P231 drinking water standards for removing bacteria and parasites, and NSF 42 for chlorine reduction.

Specifications

Volume 710ml (24 fl oz)
Weight 480g (17oz)
Microfilter life Up to 4,000L (1,000 gal)
Pore size 0.2 micron

What’s included

  • Stainless steel water bottle

  • Activated carbon filter
  • Cap with silicone mouthpiece
  • Carabiner

Ideal for

Hiking, travel, camping and everyday use wherever water quality is uncertain.

title: Petromax Cooler Bag - Dark Grey (Various Sizes)
descriptionHtml:
The Petromax Cooler Bag is essential basic gear for spending four to six days outdoors, independent from batteries and electricity. The Cooler Bag keeps your food and beverages fresh for days. You can match the colour of the bag to your purpose whether it be supplying provisions when camping, fishing, or having an adventurous picnic. Thanks to the water-repellent nylon fabric and waterproof zips, ice cubes and ice packs can be stowed safely in the Cooler Bag to keep meat, vegetables, and beverages reliably chilled. You can take the bag simply anywhere wearing the shoulder strap or using the handles. By the help of the eyelets for carabiners, you can place the Petromax Cooler Bag securely in a boat or a car. The four separate pockets provide space for small items of equipment such as the Tripod Lashing, kindling or a lighter. The bottle opener allows you to open bottle caps directly on the bag.

The Petromax Cooler Bag is available in three colours and two sizes. Fill the small Cooler Bag with up to 4 kg of ice cubes and the large Cooler Bag with up to 10 kg of ice cubes. They can hold six 0.5 L bottles or four 1.5 l bottles, respectively. Adventures in the great outdoors can last four to six days depending on the size of the bag, allowing you to cook a complete and adventurous menu in the open air. The Petromax Cooler Bags from this traditional German brand let you focus totally on your adventure and are an indispensable part of the outdoor cooking experience.

Features:

  • Compact, portable Cooler Bag for multi-day excursions in the great outdoors
  • Cooling for 4 and 6 days with ice cubes or ice packs and no need for electricity
  • Water-repellent nylon fabric, waterproof zips and dirt-resistant surfaces for long durability
  • Eyelets for carabiners, padded strap and handles plus four separate pockets make the Cooler Bag a practical catering assistant when travelling
  • A bottle opener on the back of the bag completes the Cooler Bag

title: BCB FIREDRAGON  Mini Cooker Mk2 (pocket sized)
descriptionHtml:
The FireDragon Mini Cooker Mk II is a smaller, lighter alternative to the BCB Multi-fuel Cooker. It folds flat to slip into a pocket or pack, and it is a handy bit of kit for camping, hiking and bushcraft trips.

Key features

  • Lightweight and pocket sized
  • Folds flat for storage
  • Robust, durable metal construction
  • Metal folds to suit different pot sizes
  • Adjustable wind shield and vent for a more intense burn
  • Stores two FireDragon fuel tablets inside

How to use

Unfold the cooker and shape it to fit your pot. Place a fuel tablet in the centre, light it, and set the wind shield and vent for the conditions. When packing away, store two fuel tablets inside to save space.

Safety

FireDragon fuel contains denatured ethanol and is a flammable solid. Keep it away from children, heat, sparks and open flames, and avoid breathing the vapours. It can cause serious eye irritation: if it gets in the eyes, rinse cautiously with water for several minutes.

Ideal for

Lightweight solo trips, emergency kits and brewing up on a day walk.

Stock up on FireDragon solid fuel blocks or FireDragon fuel pots, and see more solid fuel stoves.

    • Can be used as a ground cover, picnic mat, or a classic tarp shelter

The Robens Trail Tarp is a versatile and lightweight solution for camping, backpacking, or any outdoor adventure. Whether you're planning a camping trip or setting up base camp on a hike, this tarp provides essential shelter from the elements.

One of the top features of the Robens Tarpaulin is its versatility. With multiple attachment points and a variety of pitching options, you can set up this tarp in various configurations to suit your needs. Simply pitch the tarp using your hiking poles or a tarp pole.

This lightweight tarp is not limited to use as a shelter. It can also be used in numerous other ways in the great outdoors, such as a ground cover, picnic blanket, or extra layer of protection over your tent.

The Robens 3x3 Tarp is made from high-quality HydroTex® material that is highly durable and tear-resistant. It can withstand harsh weather conditions and will last you for many adventures to come. 

With a waterproof rating of 5,000mm, this tarp will even keep you dry in even the heaviest downpours. The taped seams ensure no water will leak through, keeping you dry and comfortable.

It's also incredibly lightweight, weighing only 1kg, and can be packed down to a small size, making it easy to carry on any adventure.

title: Robens Snowdon Gas Lantern
descriptionHtml:
The Robens Snowdon Gas Lantern screws straight onto a standard EN417 gas cartridge and gives off a warm, candle-like flame. There is no mantle to fit or break, and it runs for up to 56 hours on a 230g cartridge at its medium setting. It comes with its own hard case.

No mantle. Gas mantles turn brittle once lit and break easily in a pack. The Snowdon burns with an open flame behind borosilicate glass, so there are no spares to carry.

Simple to light. There is no push-button igniter to wear out. Open the valve and light it with a match or lighter.

Compact and protected. At 5 x 13cm and 122g, it is light enough for a backpacking kit. The hard case protects the glass in transit.

It suits wild campers and backpackers who want soft background light at camp rather than a bright work light. Use it outdoors or in a well-ventilated shelter, never inside a closed tent.

Brand Robens

Materials Stainless steel, aluminium, copper, borosilicate glass
Size 5 x 13cm (diameter x height)
Weight 122g
Colour Black

title: Petromax Kuksa Cup Made Of Olive Wood
descriptionHtml: What makes the Petromax Kuksa made of olive wood your perfect bushcraft cup: • Traditional kuksa shape for a cup with history • Hand-made in Germany • Sustainable as made from old olive trees that have been felled • Food-safe and highly durable due to oil wax finish • Practical leather loop to hang it by A kuksa – the traditional cup made of olive wood for every adventure The Petromax Kuksa is a traditional wooden cup: It was used as a drinking vessel, to eat from or as a container in which to collect berries. The special feature of the Petromax Kuksa is the continuous, horizontal handle which enables you to keep a secure hold of it, sip after sip. You can attach the Kuksa to your belt or rucksack by the leather loop, so it is always conveniently to hand. The Kuksa is the ideal item of equipment on outdoor adventures because it is so versatile. It can be used as a cup, for soup or as a serving dish – with a capacity of 200 ml you can even use it as a ladle or measuring cup. This genuine bushcraft cup is easy to use and highly durable. You will be able to enjoy it as part of your outdoor activities for many years to come. The history of the kuksa – where the bushcraft cup comes from Originally the owner carved their own kuksa from birch using just a few tools such as a knife and axe and added a piece of reindeer antler and a leather strap. According to tradition, the kuksa was never washed but simply rinsed in a stream or lake. The olive wood has the benefit that it is scratch-resistant, hygienic, impervious to acids and absorbs no odours – making it the ideal equipment for adventures. Due to the oil wax finish you don't have to treat the Petromax Kuksa with salt or ground coffee and can use it immediately. What makes your olive wood Kuksa so unique These kuksa cups are hand-made by Petromax in Germany from the wood of the Olea europaea tree. The olive trees are felled because the olives can no longer be harvested – making sustainable use of a resource in production. The oil wax finish applied at the end of the manufacturing process means that the cup will last for a long time and is always ready for its next use outdoors. The striking engraving of the Petromax dragon logo gives each kuksa a special touch with its very individual grain. How to care for your kuksa: You can rinse your kuksa in the traditional way using just stream water – or use gentle detergent and clean water. Dry it thoroughly after use. When required, you can apply a thin film of high-quality olive oil. Highly coloured liquids such as blackberry juice or red wine may stain the kuksa. The DD SuperLight - Bikepacker Groundsheet weighs only 150g / 5.2oz, and can be compressed down in its' stuff sack to the size of an apple! descriptionHtml:

Each strap has a single loop at one end and 14 loops at the other. Wrap the strap around the tree and feed the whole daisy chain through the single loop in a choke style. You are then left with 14 loops on the free end to clip your hammock to, so you can match the distance needed for a comfortable hang. If space is really tight, wrap the strap several times and connect the two end loops together.

Hammock campers who want flexible set-ups between awkwardly spaced trees, or need extra length in their suspension.

title: Petromax Wooden Spoon
descriptionHtml:
The Petromax wooden cooking spoon is a natural tool for outdoor cooks and home kitchens alike. It is made from local cherry wood and then oiled, which brings out the wood’s reddish colour and makes the grain stand out. Every spoon has its own grain, so yours may differ from the photo.

A classic shape, with an oval shallow bowl and a flat handle, sits comfortably in the hand, and the Petromax logo is burned into the handle by pyrography.

Material Cherry wood, oiled
Dimensions (L x W x H) 1 x 5.9 x 32cm
Weight 45g

Ideal for

Stirring stews in a Dutch oven, serving at the campfire and everyday cooking at home.

Care

Wood is a natural material and can crack in extreme conditions, so do not leave the spoon soaking in water. Clean it thoroughly with warm water and cleaning powder, then stand it on end to air-dry. When the oiled finish wears, rub in hot, flavourless vegetable oil or paraffin oil, leave it to soak in overnight and wipe off the excess. Repeat regularly.

Use it with a Petromax Dutch oven or Petromax fire skillet, and see the full Petromax range.

descriptionHtml:
The All-New Selk’bag Original 6G now with extra-features is designed for maximum mobility, comfort, and warmth so you can journey, play or sleep just about anywhere.

The Selk’bag Original 6G sleeping bag suit has a temperature rating suitable for use outdoors in the UK any time of year. We’ve given it two layers of synthetic hollow fibre insulation and a water resistant coating. This makes the Original 6G the most versatile wearable sleeping bag UK campers can pitch up in.

A proper fit is essential to fully enjoy all the Selk'bag has to offer. Please note that the sizing recommendations are provided to guide selections for best fit. A person’s unique weight and dimensions impact fit. For instance, a larger person at the upper height range may best fit the next size up; whereas a person of a smaller frame and weight at the low height range, may best fit the next size down.

In-between sizes? Please first consider the weight recommendations in the previous paragraph. Second, please understand that a looser fit is better for more comfortable sleeping, while a tighter fit is better for mobility - but may restrict sleeping comfort if booties are left on.

We always recommend to size up if you are not completely sure. It's better to have a little bit more room while using your Selk'bag!

Please keep in mind that our Original model’s higher loft of insulation, as compared to the Lite, makes it feel snugger, so we suggest you size up if you are 1'' to 3'' below the inbetween size range (i.e if you are getting the Original 6G and you are 5'9'' we recommend getting an XL)

title: Gear Aid Seam Grip + Sil Silicone Tent Sealant ( Silnet ) 28g Tube
descriptionHtml:
Seam sealing with Gear Aid Seam Grip SIL is the best way to keep water out of a silnylon (silicone-nylon) tent. Previously known as SilNet, this clear sealant dries to a flexible rubber that works on all silicone-treated gear, including tarps and ultralight rucksacks.

Only a silicone sealant will work on silnylon, because silicone only sticks to silicone. One tube seals up to 24ft of seams, and it's also handy for pinhole repairs and small tears.

A silicone seam sealer for silnylon tents

  • Bonds to silicone-treated fabrics
  • Waterproof seal that won’t peel or crack
  • Cures to a flexible, elastic rubber
  • Unaffected by extreme heat or cold
  • Seals seams and patches pinhole leaks
  • Clear finish
  • Made in USA

Specifications

Material Silicone rubber
Coverage Up to 24 ft of seams
Cure time 3-6 hours (humidity cure)
Apply at 16°C to 38°C (60-100°F)
Use temperature -29°C to 82°C (-20 to 180°F)

How to seam seal a silnylon tent

Pitch the tent so the seams are taut. Clean the seams, then apply a thin layer of Seam Grip SIL along the stitching on the outside. Leave it to cure for 3 to 6 hours before packing the tent away.

Ideal for

New trekking pole tents such as the 3F UL Lanshan, silnylon tarps and repairing small holes.

For non-silicone fabrics, see Gear Aid Seam Grip or Tenacious Tape. Browse our tent spares and the full Gear Aid range.

The BCB My Dog Walking Handy Tin puts the small things you wish you had on a walk into one pocket-sized tin. A spare lead, a light for dark evenings and basic first aid for you or your dog are all inside.

What’s in the tin

  • Emergency dog lead
  • Very bright LED micro torch
  • Small silver tweezers
  • Antiseptic wipes (6)
  • Waterproof sterile plasters (10)
  • Extremely loud distress whistle
  • Scented doggy bags (6)

Specifications

Weight 154g

Ideal for

Dog owners who walk in the countryside, on the coast or after dark, and anyone who wants a back-up lead in the car or rucksack.

Tips

Use the tweezers to pull out splinters and thorns, and top up the doggy bags and plasters after each use so the tin is always ready to go.

For tick season, add the Smidge Quick Untick card, and see more pet gear in our pet care range and from BCB International.

title: True Utility Turbojet Firewire (Keyring)

Key features

  • Adjustable flame
  • One-handed flip lid
  • Alloy body
  • Refillable with standard lighter gas
  • Keyring design, supplied in blister packaging

Ideal for

Lighting stoves and campfires, everyday carry and backup fire-lighting in an emergency kit.

How to use

Flip the lid with your thumb, ignite, and use the adjuster to set the flame. Refill with standard lighter gas when it runs low.

Keep it with the True Utility FireStash and some Flamers natural firelighters, and browse more fire-making equipment.

title: True Utility Cashstash + (Keyring)
descriptionHtml:
The True Utility CashStash+ makes sure you never go without cash in an emergency. Based on the original CashStash, the + version is small and light, so you can attach it to your key ring and carry it everywhere.

Inside the aircraft-grade aluminium capsule, a discreet stainless steel CashClip holds one note of any denomination. A neoprene O ring makes the capsule completely waterproof, so your note comes out in the same condition it went in.

Key features

  • Aircraft-grade aluminium capsule
  • Stainless steel CashClip holds one note of any denomination
  • Neoprene O ring seal, completely waterproof
  • Small and light for everyday keyring carry
  • Supplied in keyring blister packaging

Ideal for

Travellers, festival goers, walkers and runners, or anyone who wants a back-up note for taxis, parking or an emergency when cards fail.

How to use

Fold your note around the CashClip, slide it into the capsule and close it so the O ring seals it. Clip it onto your keys and forget about it until you need it.

Add a True Utility FireStash or TinyTorch to your keys, and see the full True Utility range.

title: Coghlan Nylon Tent Repair Kit
descriptionHtml:
A small rip or a snapped pole section shouldn't end your trip. The Coghlan's Nylon Tent Repair Kit has what you need to patch up nylon tents in the field, all in one resealable bag.

There are adhesive-backed nylon patches for holes in the fly or inner, mesh patches for torn insect screens, and thread and a needle for stitching. Three sizes of ferrule and a length of shock cord let you make temporary repairs to broken or loose tent poles.

What's in the kit

  • 2 adhesive-backed nylon patches
  • 2 mesh screen patches
  • 2 spools of nylon thread
  • 1 no.4 needle
  • 3 pole ferrules (8.5 mm, 9.5 mm and 11 mm)
  • 114 cm (45in) of shock cord
  • Resealable bag

For leaking seams, add Gear Aid Seam Grip + Sil for silicone tents or Stormseal Seam Sealer. Need more shock cord? Try the Highlander shock cord kit. Browse all our tent spares and add-ons.

title: DD Hammocks Pyramid Tent - Multicamo
descriptionHtml:
DD Hammocks Waterproof Camo Pyramid Tent

Blend into nature with the DD Hammocks Pyramid Tent in the classic DD Multicam pattern!

Offering great camouflage and protection from the elements, this tent is perfect for stealth or wild camping in natural environments.

Made from durable 180T polyester, this tent features a fully waterproof PU coating and taped seams, rated to 3000mm. It will withstand heavy rain and windy conditions, keeping you dry and protected during all your outdoor adventures.

The waterproof vent opposite the door helps reduce condensation and improve air circulation for a more comfortable night’s sleep, ready for a day of exploring and activities.

When paired with the DD SuperLight Pyramid Mesh Tent, this camouflaged rainfly creates a waterproof tipi-style tent that can accommodate up to two campers and their kit.

It also has an easy-to-pitch design, requiring only a single hiking pole (sold separately) or tied off to an overhead point or tree with a guy rope or cordage, thanks to the central loop. It features 4 optional guy-out points at the corners for a more secure pitch in adverse weather.

Excluding pegs, the entire shelter only weighs 670g, so it’s a fantastic choice for ultralight campers or if you need to reduce your gear weight for carrying long distances.

Please note: the DD Hammocks Pyramid Tent MC is slightly heavier than the DD SuperLight range, as the camo pattern cannot be printed on the SuperLight material.

  • DD Hammocks Pyramid Tent - MC
  • Made from 180T polyester with taped seams
  • Waterproof rated to 3000mm
  • Pitched with single hiking pole or cordage pitch
  • Weighing only 670g
  • FREE DELIVERY AVAILABLE

 

Remember to add the DD Hiking Pole to your order to easily pitch this waterproof shelter. Add the DD SuperLight Pyramid Mesh Tent for a waterproof tipi-style tent.

Material 180T Polyester
Capacity 1-2 Person
Waterproof Rating 3,000m
Weight 670g
Total Dimensions 254*200*125cm
Colour DD Multicam

 

Contents:

  • DD Hammocks Pyramid Tent - MC
  • 13 x pegs

  • Ridgeline Loks

title: Highlander Birch 2 Tent
descriptionHtml:
Quick Pitch Highlander Birch 2 Tent

The Highlander Birch 2 Tent is a fantastic choice for festivals and couples camping getaways to the wilderness.

Designed to accommodate 2 people, it offers the perfect combination of space and functionality, making your overnight stay outdoors as comfortable as possible.

The tent is designed with double-walled construction, providing an extra layer of protection against the elements.

The outer layer is made from 190T breathable polyester fabric that’s waterproof up to 2,000mm, ensuring you stay dry during rain showers. It also features a fully sewn-in groundsheet made from durable polyethylene, which helps protect you from the damp or muddy ground.

The high and low vents on the tent allow for proper ventilation and reduce condensation inside the tent for a comfortable night's sleep. It also features a large door with an insect-proof mesh screen for additional ventilation without worrying about pesky bugs ruining your rest.

Quick and easy to pitch with just two poles and a simple clip-on system, you can set up your tent in under 2 minutes, making it a great option for those who are new to camping or just want a hassle-free experience.

The tent poles are made from lightweight and sturdy fibreglass, able to withstand strong winds and provide stability in different weather conditions.

  • Highlander Outdoor Birch 2 - 2-man Dome Tent
  • Easy to pitch in under 2 minutes
  • Double-walled construction

  • 2,000mm PU coating & taped seams
  • Weighs 3kg
  • FREE DELIVERY AVAILABLE

The GSI Outdoors Folding Foon is a spoon and fork in one, designed for weight-conscious hikers. Its folding design shrinks it from six inches in use to less than four inches for storage, so it tucks neatly inside your cook kit.

At a minuscule 0.3oz, you will barely notice it in your pack, but you will be glad of it at mealtimes.

Key features

  • Folding design for compact storage
  • Six inches long in use
  • Less than four inches folded
  • Weighs just 0.3oz
  • Tucks neatly inside your cook kit

Specifications

Length in use 6in
Folded length Under 4in
Weight 0.3oz

Ideal for

Ultralight backpacking, day hikes, packed lunches and keeping a spare utensil in a car or rucksack.

Tips

Store it folded inside your mug or pot so it never goes missing at the bottom of your pack.

For eating from deep meal pouches, try the GSI Pouch Spoon, compare the UCO Eco spork, and see more camping utensils.

descriptionHtml:
The Petromax Stack Grate is made of solid cast iron and gives first-class heat distribution, exactly what you need for baking, braising and steaming on several levels inside a Dutch Oven.

It stands on three 4.8cm feet that keep food at the ideal distance from the bottom of the pot, so meat, vegetables and cakes don't burn. It fits the Dutch Oven ft4.5 and all larger pots.

  • Stack several for multi-level cooking

Ways to use it

  • In the pot: steam with one grate, or stack several
  • In the embers: sear grill marks onto meat
  • In the fire: a base for percolators, kettles or Dutch Ovens without feet
  • On the table: a trivet for hot cookware

Ideal for

Dutch Oven baking, campfire bread and cakes, steaming vegetables and campfire cooking.

Use it with the Petromax Dutch Oven or under the Petromax Perkomax percolator. Browse our cast iron cookware and the full Petromax range.

title: Petromax Cast Iron Waffle Iron (Short/Long)
descriptionHtml:
The Petromax Cast Iron Waffle Iron brings a great dessert to your outdoor cooking. Fill it with batter, hold it over the barbecue or campfire, turn once if needed, and your waffles are ready.

It bakes two 9 x 11cm waffles at a time. A locking hook keeps the halves together so batter does not leak, and cast iron's stored heat bakes them gently and evenly golden.

A campfire waffle maker in cast iron

  • Bakes two 9 x 11cm waffles
  • Cast iron, pre-seasoned and ready to use
  • Locking hook keeps the halves together
  • Comfortable wooden handles
  • Long stainless steel rod keeps you away from the heat
  • Hinged halves separate for easy cleaning
  • Natural non-stick effect
  • Short or long versions

Long version specifications

Size 3 x 20 x 72cm
Weight 2750g
Materials Cast iron, stainless steel, wood

How to use it

Heat both sides over embers, brush lightly with oil, then fill one side with batter and close. Turn once, check after a couple of minutes and cook until golden.

Ideal for

Campfire desserts, garden parties, barbecues and family camping.

See the Petromax rotating waffle iron, and browse cast iron cookware and the full Petromax range.

title: Petromax Scraper with Ridges for Cast Iron
descriptionHtml:

The toothed edge fits the grooves of all ridged Petromax cast-iron products, making it quick to clean grill surfaces with ridges, all while preserving the valuable patina.

Key features

  • Ridges remove heavy, baked-on crusts
  • Curved edge matches Petromax Dutch ovens and skillets
  • Teeth fit ridged Petromax grill surfaces
  • Preserves the seasoning and patina
  • Heat resistant up to 120°C

Specifications

Material Polypropylene (PP), food-safe
Heat resistance Up to 120°C

How to use

Because it is heat resistant to 120°C, you can clean cast iron while it is still warm or soaking in hot water, which loosens residue faster.

Use it on the Petromax Dutch Oven with Legs or a Petromax Fire Skillet, and see more cast iron cookware from Petromax.

descriptionHtml:

The titanium burner and 0.8L FluxRing pot boil half a litre in about two and a half minutes. Packed size 11.2 × 13 cm

Pair with 100g Jetpower gas. Prefer a built-in igniter? See the Flash. Browse the Jetboil range.

title: Robens Carson / Dutch oven Lid Lifter
descriptionHtml:
Lifting a hot cast iron lid off the coals is one of the trickiest parts of Dutch oven cooking. The Robens Carson Lid Lifter helps you get a safe, secure grip on the Carson or Dutch oven lid while keeping your hands away from the heat.

Use it to check on stews, bread and roasts without disturbing the coals on top, or to move the lid to one side while you stir.

Key features

  • Secure grip on a Carson or Dutch oven lid
  • Keeps your hands away from the heat

Ideal for

Campfire and fire pit cooking with a Robens Carson or similar Dutch oven, especially when cooking with hot coals on the lid.

How to use

Hook the lifter under the lid handle, lift steadily and keep the lid level so ash and coals do not slide into the food. Set the lid down on a clean, heatproof surface.

Tips

Wear heat-resistant gloves as well, as cast iron stays hot for a long time.

Use it with the Robens Carson Dutch Oven 4.3L, add Robens Fire Gloves, and see more cast iron cookware.

title: SOTO Pocket Blow Torch
descriptionHtml:
The SOTO Pocket Blow Torch uses a refillable lighter to create a powerful, compact and wind-resistant mini blow torch. It reaches temperatures of up to 1300°C, so it lights stoves, fires and candles even on breezy days.

A wind-resistant pocket torch lighter

  • Reaches up to 1300°C
  • Wind resistant
  • Handheld and pocket-sized
  • Refillable, removable lighter included

How to refill it

Refill the lighter with the SOTO Fill Adaptor (OD-TRC) or a standard gas lighter cartridge.

Safety tips

Keep the flame pointed away from you, let the nozzle cool before pocketing it, and never use it inside a closed tent. Keep it out of reach of children.

Ideal for

Lighting stoves and campfires, barbecues, candles and emergency kits.

Need more power? See the SOTO Pocket Blow Torch XT or the SOTO Micro Torch. Browse fire lighting kit and the full SOTO range.

title: Robens Tongass Enamel Kettle
descriptionHtml:
The Robens Tongass Enamel Kettle brings classic campfire style to your brew kit. It can be used directly over an open fire, and its handle is designed for use with a tripod so you can hang it above the flames.

When you get home, it is dishwasher safe, so cleaning off the soot and campfire grime is easy.

Key features

  • Suitable for use over an open fire
  • Handle designed for hanging from a tripod
  • Enamel finish
  • Dishwasher safe

Ideal for

Campfire brews, bushcraft camps, glamping and anyone who enjoys boiling water the traditional way.

How to use

Fill the kettle, hang it from a tripod over the fire or set it on a stable grate, and wait for it to boil. Lift it off using gloves, as the handle will be hot.

Tips

Avoid heating the kettle empty, and handle it with care to avoid chipping the enamel.

Hang it from the Robens telescopic tripod, match it with the Tongass single dinner set, and see more camping kettles.

title: Katadyn BeFree Filter Gravity 3L
descriptionHtml:
With the Katadyn BeFree Gravity 3L, you don't have to worry where your next drink is coming from. Fill the flask and let the EZ-Clean Membrane do the work, then gently squeeze for instant refreshment.

When you're ready to move on, the collapsible flask packs small to fit into tight spaces. Just smash, stash and go.

A 3 litre gravity water filter

  • 3L collapsible flask
  • EZ-Clean Membrane filter
  • Squeeze or hang to filter
  • Easy to clean with no tools
  • Packs down small

How to clean it

Fill the flask with water, attach the cover and shake to free debris. Or remove the filter and swish it in a lake, river or stream.

Why choose 3 litres?

A bigger reservoir means fewer trips to the water source at camp, so it's handy for groups, cooking and filling several bottles at once.

Ideal for

Group camping, base camps, backpacking and wild camping near streams and lakes.

Going solo? See the Katadyn BeFree 1L Tactical or BeFree AC 1.0L. Browse our water filters and purification.

title: DD Travel Hammock / Bivi Coyote Brown
descriptionHtml:
The double-layered DD Travel Hammock/Bivi has a built-in mosquito net and a waterproof floor. With the webbing pre-fitted and wide 60cm spreader pole/elastic included to raise the net for a spacious interior space, the Travel Hammock is a versatile system suitable for users with any level of hammock camping experience.
Great on and off the ground
The DD Travel hammock's waterproof base makes it ready to deploy on the ground as a bivi. Backpackers and long-distance hikers will appreciate this, in the event that the next campsite turns out to be tree-free!
Zip up the net for 100% bug protection, or simply unzip both sides and roll up to secure out of the way. Alternatively, suspend the hammock with the net on the bottom to lounge out in the sun! The 4 storage pouches can be used on either the interior or exterior of the hammock, all you need to do is flip them to the outside when the hammock is used with the net on the bottom!
Please Note: 
The Travel Hammock is designed for dual use (on/off ground), and is not ideal solely for use as a hammock. If you're looking for a cross-season hammock, consider the DD Frontline Hammock- it is the same design, but with breathable base layers.
Some Travel Hammock users may experience mild condensation due to the waterproof floor. This can be down to the air flow into the hammock set-up or the sleeping temperature of the individual. To increase air flow, we recommend suspending your tarp higher up or in a 'diamond' formation.
Size 2.7m x 1.4m (comfortable for people up to 6ft 5in and 125kg)
Colour  Coyote brown
Weight 930g (hammock only)
Includes Travel Hammock, Webbing (10m), 2 x elastic cord, 2 x spreader poles, stuff sack
Weight limit 125 kg
  • Double-layered design with velcro tab closure – insert a partially-inflated thermarest between the layers in cooler weather
  • Waterproof floor layer for use on the ground
  • Ultra-fine mesh mosquito net built in: zips closed and protects against all insects (even the smallest!)
  • Foldable lightweight 60cm spreader poles and two 2m lengths of elastic, to suspend the net
  • 2 x double-sided zippers for easy open and close
  • 2 x internal hanging loops for torches, glasses etc.
  • 4 pouch pockets to store small valuables - can be used whilst the hammock is in any configuration.

    FAQs

    Is the tent waterproof?

    Yes, this tent is made with a special waterproof PU coating rated 4000mm to keep you dry through any weather. The inner tent also features the same waterproof coating.

    What are the dimensions of the tent?

    Once erected, the tent has a width of 210cm, length of 210cm and height of 105cm. A small packdown size of 50cm x 15cm makes it incredibly portable.

    How much does the tent weigh?

    The Naturehike Cloud Peak tent weighs just 5.5lb (2.4kg)!

    How should I store my tent?

    Avoid packing away your tent if it is still damp or dirty. While we use the highest quality waterproofing, long-term exposure to moisture can start the process of hydrolysis - causing a sticky and non-waterproof coating on your tent materials. Just 24 hours in warm weather could be enough for mildew to begin forming, damaging its appearance and smell and likely voiding the warranty.

Thread the elastic laces through your shoes, slide the lock device on, set the tension you like, then trim the excess and fit the cord clips to the ends.

Running, triathlon, trainers, kids' shoes and anyone who wants quick on and off.

Output 3000W
Weight 189g
Packed size 7 x 6cm

Backpacking, group camping and cooking larger meals outdoors.

title: Highlander Insulating Neoprene Hose Cover (Various Colours)
descriptionHtml:
Warm water in summer and frozen tubes in winter are two of the most common hydration bladder complaints. The Highlander Insulating Neoprene Hose Cover tackles both by wrapping your drinking tube in a layer of insulation.

It keeps the liquid in your hose cooler for longer on hot days and helps stop it freezing when temperatures drop. A replacement hose is included in the pack, so you can fit a fresh tube at the same time.

Key features

  • Insulating neoprene cover for bladder hoses
  • Keeps liquid cooler for longer
  • Helps prevent water freezing in the tube
  • Replacement hose included
  • Available in various colours

Specifications

Dimensions 96cm x 1.5cm
Material Neoprene
Includes Cover and replacement hose

Ideal for

Hikers, cyclists, runners and anyone using a hydration bladder, especially in hot summers or cold winter conditions.

Tips

In freezing weather, blow the water back down into the bladder after each drink so less sits in the tube.

Use it with the Highlander Blade 2L bladder or a Hydrapak Contour 3L bladder, and see more outdoor hydration kit.

title: Miniwell Outdoor Water Filter
descriptionHtml:
The Miniwell Outdoor Water Filter turns dirty water into drinking water straight away. It is a pump action filter with a 1 litre capacity, combining a carbon filter with medical-grade ultrafiltration.

It is effective against 99.9% of protozoa, bacteria and viruses, and a single filter cleans up to 1000 litres, so it cuts down on bottled water and waste. It all packs into a handy carry case.

Key features

  • Effective against 99.9% of protozoa, bacteria and viruses
  • Cleans up to 1000L per filter
  • Carbon filter with medical-grade ultrafiltration
  • Pump action with 1 litre capacity
  • Packs into its own carry case

Specifications

Capacity 1L
Filter life Up to 1000L
Dimensions 16.5 x 5 x 8cm
Colour Olive

Ideal for

Wild camping, hiking, emergency kits and military or cadet activities where clean water is not guaranteed.

Tips

Collect water from the clearest source you can find to make the filter last longer. Carry a few Aquatabs purification tablets as a backup, and compare more options in water filters and purification.

title: FireDragon Liquid Fire Lighter
descriptionHtml:
FireDragon Liquid is an all-weather, eco-friendly biofuel and firelighter made from UK-sourced ethanol. It is manufactured in its own FireDragon factory in Llanelli.

Use it as a fuel in multi-fuel outdoor cooking stoves, including Trangia cookers, or in indoor ethanol fireplaces. It lights with just a spark, a lighter or a match and keeps a steady, high-quality flame right to the end of the burn.

Key features

  • Quick and easy to ignite with a spark, lighter or match
  • Made in the UK from traceable, sustainable, naturally derived bioethanol
  • Non-toxic and odourless, burns clean without noxious fumes
  • Constant, high-quality flame temperature
  • Works indoors or outside in all weather, even when wet
  • Easy to store and handle
  • Safe to pack with food

Ideal for

Trangia and spirit stove users, bushcrafters lighting fires in wet weather, and anyone with an indoor ethanol fireplace.

Tips

Keep the bottle upright and sealed in your pack, and only refuel a stove once the flame is out and the burner has cooled.

Also try FireDragon solid fuel blocks and BCB windproof matches, and browse more camping gas and fuel.

descriptionHtml:
Collapsible & Portable Katadyn Filter Bottle

  • 100% PVC & BPA-free collapsible water bottle for hydration anytime, anywhere

Stay hydrated with clean filtered water on the go with the Katadyn BeFree Water Filter Bottle!

This collapsible bottle features a hollow fibre filter that removes bacteria, cysts, and sediment from water sources, serving you up with clean drinking water when you need it most.

The filter has a 0.1-micron pore size, ensuring even the tiniest contaminants are removed, but essential minerals and nutrients are retained for your health.

The bottle itself is made from 100% BPA-free and PVC-free materials, making it safe for everyday use. It also collapses easily, so it can be slotted into biking shorts, running vests, or backpacks for easy access.

We stock two capacities depending on how much water you need to carry – 600ml and 1000ml. Both bottles are lightweight even when filled, so won’t lug you down on your adventures.

Specifications

Size 600ml

1,000ml
Materials Hydrapak SoftFlask plastic, EZ-Clean Membrane
Colour Clear

Contents

  • 1 x Katadyn BeFree Water Bottle

FAQs

How Do You Clean the Katadyn Water Filter Bottle?

To clean the Katadyn water bottle, simply swish the EZ-Clean filter in clean water. This quick process effectively removes debris and keeps the filter functioning efficiently, ensuring you always have access to safe drinking water.

What Does the Katadyn Water Filter Bottle Remove?

The Katadyn portable water bottle filter removes bacteria, cysts, and sediment, ensuring safe drinking water. With its 0.1-micron pore size, it effectively filters out harmful substances while allowing beneficial minerals to pass through for optimal hydration.

How Long Does The Katadyn Water Filter Bottle Last?

This camping water bottle lasts up to 1,000 litres, depending on water quality. Regular cleaning of the EZ-Clean filter is essential to maintaining efficiency and extending its lifespan for reliable performance on outdoor adventures.

What Liquid Can I Put in the Katadyn Filter Bottle?

We’d recommend just sticking to water with the Katadyn Filter Bottle. While it may be tempting to filter other liquids, such as juice or electrolyte drinks, the filter is specifically designed for water and may not effectively remove impurities from other liquids.

title: Nikwax TX Direct Wash-In 300ml
descriptionHtml:
When your raingear starts soaking up water, Nikwax TX.Direct Wash-In restores its Durable Water Repellency (DWR). It is the market-leading wash-in waterproofer, designed specifically for breathable waterproof garments.

Because it goes in the washing machine, the treatment reaches right through the garment, covering seams, tapes and cords as well as the fabric. Water repellency develops as the garment air dries, so there is no need to tumble dry, which saves energy and protects older garments from heat.

Key features

  • Wash-in waterproofing for wet weather gear
  • Machine or hand wash application
  • Maintains breathability
  • Full water repellency without tumble drying
  • Water-based, non-flammable and fluorocarbon-free

How to use

Clean the garment first with Nikwax Tech Wash in a separate cycle; there is no need to dry it before waterproofing. Remove any non-washable parts and clear detergent build-up from the dispenser. Put a maximum of 2 garments in the machine, use 100ml per garment and run a 30°C synthetic cycle with a slow spin. Do not machine wash garments with dislodged taped seams.

Tips

Dirt and detergent residue mask DWR, so always wash waterproofs with Nikwax Tech Wash rather than ordinary detergent. If your jacket is fairly new, cleaning alone may be enough.

Start with Nikwax Tech Wash, use TX.Direct Spray-On for targeted areas, and see the full Nikwax range.

title: Nikwax TX.Direct® Spray-On 300ml
descriptionHtml:
Nikwax TX.Direct Spray-On is a quick, easy spray-on waterproofer for wet weather gear. Its Durable Water Repellency (DWR) develops as it air dries, so there is no need to tumble dry, which saves energy and protects older or more delicate garments from heat.

It is designed for breathable waterproof clothing, leaving a flexible water-repellent treatment on individual fibres so moisture vapour can still escape. Spraying lets you target the areas that need it most, such as elbows and seams, without affecting internal wicking liners.

Key features

  • Spray-on waterproofing for wet weather gear
  • Maintains breathability
  • Full water repellency develops on air drying
  • Water-based, non-aerosol, non-flammable
  • Fluorocarbon-free, with no harmful solvents or VOCs
  • 300ml

Why water repellency matters

If the outer fabric of a jacket soaks up water, it can lose up to 70% of its breathability, leaving you damp inside. Keeping the DWR topped up keeps you comfortable.

How to use

Your raingear may be soaking up water simply because it is dirty. Clean it first with Nikwax Tech Wash. If the garment is fairly new, cleaning alone may revive the DWR. Once it has been well worn, spray on TX.Direct after cleaning and let it air dry.

Prefer a wash-in treatment? Try TX.Direct Wash-In, or see the full Nikwax range.

title: Soto Stormbreaker  Multi Fuel Stove With Fuel Bottle
descriptionHtml:
The SOTO StormBreaker is a compact and powerful multi-fuel stove. It’s burner head fires 300 micro-flames to create the main jet. It also utilises the same wind-beating, low-profile, technology featured in the award-winning WindMaster. This means a faster boiling time with less fuel consumption. The StormBreaker can be powered by either white liquid fuels or screw-thread gas cartridges. For example, if you’re using it as a liquid fuel stove it can work with Coleman Fuel,  unleaded petrol, or similar. Please note that this stove is not compatible with diesel. Alternatively, with the gas converter, you can use this stove with a standard isobutane screw cartridge. The stove has folding legs that act as the pot support and offer a wide base for stability. The fuel flows through a hose into the stove in an “alpine” style to help keep everything lower to the ground, which helps reduce the risk of it being knocked or blown over. At the same time, this style of stove helps improve fuel flow with gas cartridges as it inverts the cylinder.

Gas canister not included 

Key Features:

  • Multi-fuel – works with white liquid fuels (white gas aka Coleman Fuel, unleaded petrol, aviation fuel) and butane/iso-butane gas cartridges.
  • Self Priming – no need to preheat.
  • Instantly change the type of fuel by switching fuel-line bayonet.
  • Gas conversion unit inverts the cartridge to help improve fuel flow.
  • Concave burner head for flame resistance in windy conditions.
  • Easy to maintain – the generator unit consists of 3 parts. No need to remove the jet to clean.
  • Output: 3500W / 11780BTU
  • Weight: 273g / 443g with Smart Pump

Made In Japan

SOTO is part of a third-generation family-owned business (Shinfuji Burner Company), who have 40+ years of engineering experience behind them. Specialising in stove and burner technology SOTO are dedicated to the pursuit of manufacturing the best stoves in the world.

title: Petromax Wrought Iron Pan (Various sizes)
descriptionHtml:
Petromax Wrought Iron Pans are made from high-quality wrought iron with great heat conductivity, ideal for searing the perfect steak outdoors or at home. Use them on any cooker or stove, and even over an open fire.

Wrought iron can reach very high temperatures and passes the heat straight into your food, so meat, fish and vegetables fry beautifully. It's very long-lasting, and it actually gets better with each use.

A natural non-stick patina

A protective, self-sealing layer forms on the pan's surface from the first use. This patina keeps developing as you cook, so the pan gets darker and tougher, and food stops sticking. You can roast, fry and braise, then take it straight to the table to serve. The welded handle is secure in the hand.

SP 20 20 cm 14 cm
SP 24 24 cm 18 cm
SP 28 28 cm 21 cm
SP 32 32 cm 25 cm

Good to know

Due to the nature of wrought iron, edges may show slight rust marks when new. These wipe off, and protection increases once the pan is used.

Ideal for

Steaks, burgers and campfire breakfasts, cooking over fire pits and BBQs, induction and gas hobs at home.

title: Petromax Rocket Stove Portable Wood Burning Camp Stove
descriptionHtml:
The Petromax Rocket Stove rf33 combines the stack effect with the wood boiler principle for extremely efficient burning of wood, pine cones and other biomass.

Its L-shaped fuel support, combustion chamber and chimney vent give an optimal air supply. Heat is kept in a small, insulated space and stored in the cast iron top, ready to cook on.

A portable rocket stove for wood fired cooking

  • Burns wood, pine cones and other biomass
  • L-shaped fuel support, combustion chamber and chimney
  • Insulated body keeps heat in the combustion chamber
  • Cast iron top stores heat for cooking
  • Feed fuel through the support to regulate the fire
  • Sturdy and durable
  • Handles for carrying

How to use it

Light a small fire in the chamber using dry kindling, then feed sticks through the fuel support as needed. Set your pan or Dutch oven on the cast iron top once it is hot.

Fire safety

Use the stove outdoors on a stable, non-flammable surface, keep it away from tents and overhanging branches, and let it cool fully before moving.

Ideal for

Outdoor kitchens, garden cooking, campsites, vanlife and emergency cooking.

Cook on it with a Petromax fire skillet or Petromax Dutch oven. Browse wood burning stoves and the full Petromax range.

title: Petromax Perkomax Tea and Coffee Percolator (Various Colours)
descriptionHtml:
The Petromax Perkomax makes aromatic tea or coffee with very little effort. Its percolator principle gives a delicious, full-bodied flavour, and it can prepare up to nine cups at a time.

It's made for indoor and outdoor use, and works over a campfire or barbecue, on a hotplate, a ceramic hob and an induction cooker.

A campfire coffee percolator

  • 1.3 litre capacity
  • Up to nine cups of coffee or tea
  • Enamelled steel
  • Works on campfire, BBQ, hotplate, ceramic hob and induction

How a percolator works

As the water heats, it rises up a small tube and flows over the coffee in the round filter at the top. It drips back down through the coffee into the pot, mixes and rises again. The longer it circulates, the stronger your coffee or tea becomes.

Tips for perfect percolator coffee

Use a coarse grind so grounds don't pass through the filter. Once it starts to perk, move it to a gentler heat. Brewing time depends on the heat source and amount of water, so taste and adjust.

Ideal for

Campsite mornings, campervans, group camping, bushcraft and the kitchen at home.

Boiling water too? See the Petromax Tea Kettle. Set it on a Petromax stack grate over the fire. Browse our camping kettles and the full Petromax range.

title: Char Cord / Char Rope 50 cm
descriptionHtml:
Char cord works much like char cloth: it is a charred natural material that catches even the smallest spark. Its big advantage is that it smoulders more slowly and efficiently, which gives you more time to turn an ember into a flame. That makes it better suited to starting a fire.

It is made entirely in Germany, right down to the rope itself, which comes from a German ropery.

Key features

  • Catches the smallest spark
  • Smoulders slower than char cloth
  • Approximately 50cm long
  • Made entirely in Germany

How to use

Hold the end of the cord against your tinder and strike a spark onto it with a fire steel. Once it glows, nest it in a tinder bundle and blow gently.

Good to know

The fire steel shown in the photos is not included. Because of how it is made, a small section of the rope may not be fully pyrolysed. If so, an extra piece of char cord is added at final inspection.

Strike it with the UCO Titan Fire Striker, compare with Petromax Char Cloth, and see more fire making equipment.

descriptionHtml:

A Bushbox case with lots of uses

title: MSR Reactor® Stove Systems (Various Sizes)
descriptionHtml:
Not only is the Reactor Stove System the fastest and most fuel-efficient stove ever made, but it’s also the only one that delivers that level of performance in the cold and wind of the real world. While that might sound like hype, take a look at these test results and see exactly what that means to you in the field. Simply put, you’ll burn less fuel, carry less fuel, and move faster than with any other stove available. And with MSR’s proven quality and durability, you can be assured of that performance to pull you through when you need it most.

  • Integrated System: State-of-the-art stove and high-efficiency cookware are combined into a compact, self-contained and easy-to-use system.
  • Unrivalled Boil Time: Outperforms the competition in head-to-head lab tests—boiling .5 litre of water in just 1.5 minutes—with an even greater advantage out in the real world.
  • Unmatched Wind Protection: Heat exchanger completely encloses radiant burner head, virtually eliminating the effects of wind to maintain outstanding boil times and save fuel.
  • Maximum Efficiency: Patent-pending radiant burner, heat exchanger and internal pressure regulator produce best-in-class, fuel-sipping efficiency in all conditions.
  • Compact: All systems are self-contained, fitting the stove and fuel inside the pot. (1.0L Reactor System nests optimally with our new, smaller-diameter 4 oz. canisters, which are sold separately)

Stove System Options

Complete Reactor Stove Systems are now available in three sizes:

1.0L System: For trips with 1-2 people, or anywhere weight and space are at a premium.

1.7L System: All-around performer with the capacity to boil water and melt snow fast for two or more.

2.5L System: Boils enough for five freeze-dried meals at once, or make it an expedition snow-melting powerhouse for 2-3 people.

All Systems Include: Reactor Pot and Stove, BPA-Free Strainer Lid, PackTowl® Pot Protector, and folding/locking handle

descriptionHtml:

title: DD Hammock Underblanket - Olive Green
descriptionHtml:
Suitable for use in temperatures down to -5C, the DD Underblanket works to prevent heat loss from beneath you. Hang it under your hammock, and feel the warmth generated in minutes for a cosy night's sleep! In our opinion, this is the best hammock insulation for a cold night in the wilds!
 
How does it work?
In hammock camping, the majority of heat loss is from below due to your body weight compressing your clothing or the loft in your sleeping bag. The DD Hammock Underblanket combats this by hanging below your hammock so the loft is not compressed, creating a pocket of air warmed by your body heat. It should be hung with a little slack to gently 'hug' the hammock when you're inside, to achieve the warmest insulation.
 
Our DD Underblanket is 2m long, so will provide near full-length insulation for most people. We recommend setting it up with a little bias towards your head.
 
The DD Underblanket is compatible with all our hammocks produced since 2012. Ordinarily, its cords can be clipped onto the small tabs along the sides of your hammock.
 
If using with the SuperLight Jungle, Scout and XL Frontline or any other hammocks without side tabs - hang your underblanket from these models using just the four elastics at the ends, then draw in the sides. Or alternatively, fix the remaining cords to the four large side tabs meant for the curved poles.

title: Ganzo Gg8012 Survival Bushcraft Knife - Orange
descriptionHtml:
The Ganzo Survival Bushcraft knife a perfect knife for any survival or bushcraft user from beginner to pro. With a Built-in Fire Starting Rod, Blade Sharpener as well as a belt cutter you pretty much have everything you need to survive a knight in the wild or your back garden. Blade material for F803 is 8CR13 steel which is one of the most quality stainless alloys. This alloy has 58HRC hardness. The shape of the blade is quite universal - drop point. It is a well-balanced blade with a smooth sharpening and a sharp tip. Its thickness is 5 mm, which provides a significant margin of safety. The length of the blade is 115 mm. F803 model can help you to prepare fish you have caught, and cook sandwiches, and also carry out auxiliary work. Its blade is unusual in that it has a black coating made with special powder paint. In the process of using the F803 knife, it is not erased but requires careful handling during the grinding of the knife. The handle for the F803 model is made of thermoplastic ASB. It is a very strong material that is well protected from various types of corrosion, easily tolerates contact with water. The main part of the handle is made in black, but the small areas on the front sides are bright orange, which makes it easy to find the knife in the grass, on the sand and other areas. In addition, small light-insulating inserts are integrated into the handle of the knife. Also, there is a glass breaker at the butt which can be useful in emergency situations. An important element of the kit is the sheath for the Firebird F803 knife. It's made of plastic and nylon, easily adjustable in length so that the knife inside is sealed as tightly as possible. With the help of such sheath, you can safely carry your knife on the waist belt. On the front side of the sheath, the flint is placed. It can be used as a fully separate accessory. On the backside, you can find a small diamond sharpener, which will always help maintain the proper sharpness of the blade. Also, sheath has a strap-cutter which also makes this kit handy for survival issues.

Blade Edge Plain

title: Condor Terrasaur Bushcraft Knife Desert
descriptionHtml:
DESIGN BY JOE FLOWERS Joe Flowers, the designer for Condor® Tool and Knife, collaborated with custom makers on a multi-use fixed blade knife in 2009, suitable for bushcrafters, hunters, adventurers, and all woodsmen. The Condor Terrasaur Knife was the result. Now, Condor will be making the first production version of the knife, in a compact value-based package. The goal of the Condor Terrasaur is to make an affordable super bushcraft knife that can be used by anyone, from the beginner all the way to the expert woodsman.  With an indestructible polymer handle and ambidextrous sheath, backed by Condor’s lifetime warranty, the Terrasaur has arrived. BLADE MATERIAL: 3mm -1075 HIGH CARBON STEEL BLADE FINISH: Coated BLADE LENGTH: 105.4mm HANDLE: HIGH IMPACT POLYPROPYLENE SHEATH: POLYPROPYLENE BLADES are made from English 420 HC (High Carbon) surgical quality Stainless Steel or German 1075 High Carbon Steel and are heat treated and annealed to about 52-54 Rockwell for the machetes (a measure of hardness) and 56-58 for the knives. Every edge is hand finished and polished to razor sharpness.
AXE HEADS AND SHOVEL BLADES are made from 1045 High Carbon Steel. Axes are heat treated and annealed to 45-50 Rockwell (a measure of hardness) and shovels to 40-45.
VACUUM ASSIST INVESTMENT CASTING is a special manufacturing process that we use to make some of our axes and knives in 440C Stainless Steel. This process allows for greater product detail and strength.
BLASTED SATIN FINISH is achieved by sand or bead blasting the exposed metal portion of the blade.
ULTRABLAC2 FINISH is a black oxide finish for greater rust prevention that also provides a tactical look. This special finish is cooked into the metal at 285°F. The finish coating meets and exceeds many military specifications from the U.S. and other elite tactical groups around the world, and is well known for metal protection and abrasion resistance.
MYSTIC CAMO FINISH  is a secret finishing process developed by Condor® Tool & Knife to add a random black and grey camo pattern to its blades. This process involves no painting or other surface additions. This special finish becomes part of the blade surface and will not rub off.
EPOXY BLACK POWDER COATING  is a heavy black paint finish done by powder coating.
CONDOR® BLACK TEXTURED POWDER COATING  provides a tough and durable blade finish. It is also textured, not reflective for tactical use.
CONDOR® NATURAL FINISH  is a roughed out metal look that can be just as eye-catching as any other finish, and similar to a well-worked pair of jeans. This special treatment over the top of the blade helps repel rust.
CONDOR® CLASSIC FINISH  is a perfected process of hand hammering our Classic Series of axes and knives. It gives a classic and enhanced look to an already well-made tool. Our employees use hand-powered equipment to put this traditional pattern on, to give it a look as if it was hand forged over 200 years ago. The Classic series is a hit with historical camping fans, mountain men, and colonial period war reenactors.
POSZEGRIP SANTOPRENE® HANDLES are strong but have just the right amount of softness to provide a true cushioned grip. These handles are moulded directly to the knife blades, have a non-slip texture, and feature a full tang construction with a metal lanyard eyelet that passes through the tang for added strength.
HIGH IMPACT POLYPROPYLENE HANDLES are strong and indestructible. These handles are moulded directly to our machetes and knives blades making them impossible to separate. The tang on our polypropylene handle continues to the back of the handle, with a metal lanyard passing through it for added strength.
AMERICAN HICKORY HANDLES are used in our axes, the wood is selected for proper grain orientation and specially assembled for maximum comfort and durability.
HARDWOOD HANDLES are made from hardwoods of Central America, similar to Hickory, and are used in some of our machetes and knives. They are finished with a smooth grip and are known for their long durability.
MICARTA® HANDLES are used in some of our tools, enhancing both the look and function while delivering indestructible phenolic performance.
PARACORD WRAPPED HANDLES are made with real 500 lb test parachute cord that has seven inner strands for further use in a situation, where 1 piece of rope might not be enough.  One of the strands inside can also be teased apart further, providing fishing line, sewing thread, or help in any situation where a fine, sturdy line is needed.
CONDOR® TORTURE RING is used constantly to test the quality of our products.  Our blades have great flexibility and strength. Quality blades do not need to be thick to perform; thinner, lighter and faster is better. We test all our blades in real-world situations so we can get feedback and assure that each piece is a quality tool. Our designers and employees also use tools all over the wildernesses of North, Central, and South America and give feedback to improve product performance.
CONDOR® LEATHER SHEATHS are high quality, heavy-duty, handcrafted leather. Some of the designs feature a swivelling belt loop that allows the tool to swing out of the way while moving through brush or the jungle. The tool can also be swung out of the way while riding in a truck or car, thus not poking one in the side as a conventional knife sheath.
CONDOR® KYDEX® SHEATHS are handcrafted with quality and pride and are impervious to the elements. Each comes with a breakaway ball chain necklace.
CONDOR® BALLISTIC NYLON SHEATHS are used in many of our tactical knives as requested by our customers. These sheaths are far quieter than Kydex ® and are MOLLE compliant. Condor’s special sheath shop conducted research to find materials that would be sturdy, and each sheath is double stitched and reinforced for heavy-duty use.
LIMITED LIFETIME WARRANTY Condor® tools are warranted to be free of defects in materials, manufacture or assembly for the lifetime of the original purchaser. Damage due to abuse, misuse or neglect is not covered. Defective products will be repaired, replaced or substituted with the same item or item of equal value. To get service under warranty, send the product, postage paid, to the address listed below. You may also have other rights which vary from state to state. Wooden axe handles are not warranted by Condor®, but replacement handles are available for purchase. All of the axe heads are warranted.

title: Marttiini Tundra GR Bushcraft Knife - Curly Birch
descriptionHtml:
The Tundra is a tough performer

The Tundra is a full-blooded bushcraft all-round knife for the demanding user. This bushcraft knife is designed for heavy-duty use. Made of high-strength stainless steel, the full tang structure and robust blade provide excellent durability. The blade and the full tang are 3.5 mm thick. On this knife, traditional materials go hand in hand with modern design. The handle is made of Finnish curly birch. The red details on the handle and leather sheath seal the dynamic look. The Tundra knife is available with two handle options: deadwood-like, grey-waxed curly birch and natural-coloured, waxed curly birch. The surface of the waxed wood and the design of the handle ensure a firm grip. The sturdy leather sheath is reinforced with rivets. If needed, the knife handle parts can be re-tightened. The screw has a Torx T10 head.

Additional product information

Length of blade

11 cm

Total length

22 cm

Blade material

stainless steel

Handle material

curly birch, waxed

Sheath material

leather, brown
PROPERTIES
Bushcraft full tang 3.5mm 1.4116, HRC 58

Stainless chromium steel

The stainless steel used by Marttiini is easy to maintain as a blade material. A stainless steel blade remains sharp for long. Chromium makes up 13% of the steel mixture and the hardness of the mixture is 53-54 Rockwell units (HRC). A diamond sharpener is recommended for sharpening chromium steel.

Rubber mixture

Rubber mixture is extremely well suited as the material for knife handles. An ergonomically shaped rubber handle can be washed in a washing machine, is easy to maintain, hygienic and safe. A rubber handle feels pleasantly warm to touch even under outdoor conditions, for instance in freezing or wet weather. The roughened part of the handle and the finger guard guarantee a safe and firm grip for knives of the Condor-series.

Leather sheath

The leather sheaths of Marttiini knives are made with either vegetable or chrome tanned oxhide. The leather hides are purchased from both Europe and South America. The sheaths are made with both dyed and natural coloured leather. The knife sheaths are still made mostly by hand. Each sheath has to be exactly the right size and shape, so it forms a fitting pair with the knife. A section of the leather is cut with a model iron, and the seams are attached with glue before sewing. Most sheaths have a plastic piece inside that supports the sheath and protects the blade. The printing on the sheath is made on either the cut section or the finished sheath. Rivets, and in some cases a bronze collar, strengthen and adorn the sheath.

descriptionHtml:
The Kombat UK Fire Starter Kit is an ultra-compact, portable fire-starting kit sealed in an aluminium tin. The tinder is sealed to keep moisture out, so it is ready when you need it.

Bushcraft, survival kits, cadets, DofE and emergency bags.

title: Kombat UK  Elite Fire Starter (Black or Orange)
descriptionHtml:
The Kombat UK Elite Fire Starter is a high-quality fire starter that packs down into its own easy-to-carry waterproof container.

The container attaches to the rod to give you a better grip while striking.

A waterproof fire starter for bushcraft

  • High-quality fire starter
  • Packs into its own waterproof container

How to use a fire starter

Prepare dry tinder such as cotton wool, birch bark or tinder fungus. Hold the rod close to the tinder and strike firmly down its length with a striker or the back of a knife, aiming the sparks into the tinder. Gently blow to bring it to flame.

Ideal for

Bushcraft, survival kits, wild camping and lighting stoves without matches.

title: Petromax Fire Plunger Combustion Fire Starter
descriptionHtml: Making fire the reliable and original way, no matter where the journey is heading: The Petromax Fire Plunger combines century-old technology and compact handling in one device. Due to the strong air compression when pressing down the plunger forcefully into the plunger body, the tinder inside is brought to a glow. Move this glow and thus light your campfire or outdoor kitchen. The Fire Plunger is shorter than a hand in length and is stowed in the practical transport pouch. It fits in any kind of luggage and can also be carried along comfortably in the trouser pocket. Containers for tinder and lubricant are placed at the respective ends of plunger and plunger body and are thus optimally protected from moisture. After fitting tinder onto the plunger top it is ready to use. In addition, inside the plunger a firesteel is placed and provides a solid ignition option. Regardless of weather conditions, electricity or any other igniter – with the Petromax Fire Plunger you are best equipped for exciting bushcraft and survival adventures. Also light your campfire kitchen with the Petromax Fire Plunger and thus fully enjoy the freedom of outdoor cooking.

title: Petromax Chain Mail Cleaner For Cast And Wrought Iron
descriptionHtml:
The Petromax Chain Mail Cleaner shifts burnt-on food from cast iron without stripping your hard-earned seasoning. It is made from durable stainless steel and works on cast iron, wrought iron and stainless steel.

How to clean cast iron with chain mail

  1. Let the cookware cool down.
  2. Add some warm water and gently scrub off the burnt residue with the chain mail. No washing-up liquid is needed.
  3. Rinse the pan once more.
  4. Dry it thoroughly before storing to prevent corrosion.

Why use a chain mail scrubber?

  • Removes stuck-on residue
  • Protects the patina on cast iron
  • Stainless steel and durable
  • No detergent needed
  • Suits cast iron, wrought iron and stainless steel

Ideal for

Dutch ovens, skillets, griddles and campfire cookware.

Use it on a Petromax Dutch oven or Petromax fire skillet. Browse cast iron cookware and the full Petromax range.
