title: SnugPak Dri-Saks Black (Various sizes)
descriptionHtml:
A heavy duty waterproof storage bag with roll and clip seal to ensure contents stay dry, keeping your equipment safe from the elements, as well as storing essential equipment in your pack, requires a performance dry bag that is 100% waterproof. Tough ventures and inclement weather place extra demands on your kit, and there is nothing worse than finding equipment wet, or at worse, damaged, when out on the hills. The Snugpak® Dri-Sak™ is made from robust, lightweight nylon fabric and reinforced hem and buckle for a roll-down waterproof enclosure.

They are available in three colours and the following five sizes:

4L Small - Perfect from individuals items, venture smocks, and lightweight sleeping bags.
8L Medium - Grouped items, clothing as well as 2-3 Season Sleeping Bags.
13L Large - Ideal as a small rucksack liner to segregate equipment, for or an entire sleeping system.
20L X-Large - Used for bulkier items, & complete expedition packs including 4 Season Sleeping Systems.
35L XX-Large - Used to segregate expedition rucksacks (>40L) and create an enclosed waterproof pack.

Dimensions:
Small 4L: 24cm x 36cm / 9" x 14"
Medium 8L: 17xm x 44cm / 7" x 17"
Large 13L: 22cm x 48cm / 9" x 19"
X-Large 20L: 25cm x 53cm / 10" x 21"
XX-Large 35L: 30cm x 64cm / 12" x 25"

Weight:
Small: 70g / 2.5oz
Medium: 90g / 3.2oz
Large: 110g / 3.9oz
XLarge: 130g / 4.6oz
XXLarge: 160g / 5.6oz

Synthetic Insulation and other equipment need to be protected when not worn, and in inclement weather, water can penetrate your pack from all angles, inside and out. The Snugpak® Dri-Sak™ creates an enclosed 100% waterproof environment for essential equipment, and is made from a lightweight nylon fabric; additional D-rings allow the Dri-Sak™ to be clipped together, or secured vertically/horizontally in your pack to minimise movement when moving over difficult and dangerous terrain. The 100% waterproof material also keeps out sand, dust and snow, for overseas and colder ventures and expeditions, and they are a great way of separating wet/dry and clean/dirty items of clothing and equipment. In an emergency, they design can also be used to carry emergency water supplies, as an impromptu bladder, if required. If inflated without contents, they also make excellent emergency pillows!

Proper Use: The Snugpak® Dri-Sak™ is not designed to be submerged for extended periods of time. Once you have placed your items inside, expel as much as possible, to reduce the overall pack size, and then roll down the reinforced hem at least three times before closing with the buckle. If storing other equipment, be careful with sharp edges or abrasive items that damage the inner face of the material.

title: DD Hammock Underblanket - Multicamo
descriptionHtml:
Suitable for use in temperatures down to -5C, the DD Underblanket works to prevent heat loss from beneath you. Hang it under your hammock, and feel the warmth generated in minutes for a cosy night's sleep! In our opinion, this is the best hammock insulation for a cold night in the wilds!
 
How does it work?
In hammock camping, the majority of heat loss is from below due to your body weight compressing your clothing or the loft in your sleeping bag. The DD Hammock Underblanket combats this by hanging below your hammock so the loft is not compressed, creating a pocket of air warmed by your body heat. It should be hung with a little slack to gently 'hug' the hammock when you're inside, to achieve the warmest insulation.
 
Our DD Underblanket is 2m long, so will provide near full-length insulation for most people. We recommend setting it up with a little bias towards your head.
 
DD Multicamo 
If you're looking for natural, seamless camouflage then look no further! Research, meticulous design and testing spanning over 2 years has allowed us to bring you our own Multicam (MC) pattern – available across a limited (but growing) product selection. The pattern is designed to blend in with woodlands, mountain environments and more.
 
The DD Underblanket is compatible with all our hammocks produced since 2012. Ordinarily, its cords can be clipped onto the small tabs along the sides of your hammock.
 
If using with the SuperLight Jungle, Scout and XL Frontline or any other hammocks without side tabs - hang your underblanket from these models using just the four elastics at the ends, then draw in the sides. Or alternatively, fix the remaining cords to the four large side tabs meant for the curved poles.

title: Water To Go 75CL Active 3-in-1 Filter water bottle
descriptionHtml:
The Water-to-Go 75cl Active bottle includes a unique 3-in-1 filter with a BPA-free bottle, and click lid with integral drinking spout and protective, flip cap cover. It is perfect for those with a healthy, on-the-go lifestyle and this filter bottle has been specifically designed to fit in bike cages.

Our unique 3-in-1 filter has been created based on technology originally developed for the NASA space programme.

The filter works instantly to protect against bacteria, parasites and microplastics, reduces chemicals like chlorine and improves water taste.

The three technologies used in a Water-to-Go filter are:

  1. Mechanical filtration; a very small pore size which stops contaminants passing through.
  2. Electrical (by a positive charge) which reduces the pore size even further and attracts contaminants like a magnet,trapping them inside the filter.
  3. Activated carbon -our filters use activated carbon without using adhesives that would vastly reduce the carbon’s efficiency. Instead the activated carbon is contained within the filter membrane itself. This technique helps further reduce the contaminants whilst also eliminating bad tastes and odours.

The filter is an ideal deal for hiking, camping, international travel and emergencies, it allows you to take any non-salt water from a stream, river, or tap and filter it instantly.  Once the filter is activated and your bottle is full you are ready to drink, no need to remove the lid and filter until your ready to fill your bottle again.

The filter removes:

  • 99.9999% for bacteria like E.Coli
  • 99.999-99.9999%  for viruses like Polio
  • 99.99% for micro-organisms
  • Heavy metals (like lead) and also Chlorine and Fluoride are also filtered

 

Please be advised products may be slightly different from the picture as some come with Red or Black bands

Produced in the heart of the French Alps since 1890, the Opinel pocket knife draws its simplicity and durability from its mountain roots. It's now a recognised design icon, handed down from generation to generation, and still a favourite for DIY, camping and countryside picnics.

Carbon steel takes a very keen edge and is easy to sharpen, but it can rust. Wipe it dry after use, oil it lightly now and then, and expect it to develop a natural dark patina over time.

title: UST TekFire LED Fuel-Free Lighter, Orange
descriptionHtml:
The lightweight and compact TekFire LED Fuel-Free Lighter allows for quick and easy fire starting and features a bright LED light. Windproof, flameless, and electronic, it requires no butane fuel or adjustments for altitude. The included ParaTinder™ wrist lanyard can be unwound for about 3 feet of all-purpose paracord with an added single tinder thread. The lighter also comes with a USB cord for easy recharging from any USB port. NOTE: Only ignite inner red core strand of ParaTinder. Do not ignite white inner core strands or outer coloured jacket. These can melt plastic residue on electrodes blocking the electrical arc and prevent lighter from working. TO CLEAR RESIDUE FROM ELECTRODES: Use a wooden toothpick or plastic knife to gently scrape clear. To avoid electric shock or burn, DO NOT push electric arc button on while cleaning.  
TekFire™ LED Fuel-Free Lighter, Orange Features

    LED light and lighter work independently, powered by USB-rechargeable lithium-ion battery
    To operate lighter, release wire safety catch and press the black button to open lid; hold down the front power button
    To turn light on, press power button 2 times; press twice for off.  Light will not engage when the lighter is operating
    The indicator light flashes red while charging and is solid red when fully charged
    Lighter has 10-second time-out safety feature
    To ignite ParaTinder, expose red core thread and light with the TekFire
    Use inner paracord strands for sewing thread, sutures, fishing line, and more
    Complete use and care instructions included
Over 18s only

title: DD Hammock Quilt - Olive Green
descriptionHtml:
DD Hammock Quilt: A Lighter Alternative to a Sleeping Bag

New improved design for 2020. The DD Hammock Quilt makes an ideal comfort solution for spring-to-autumn camping. A lighter alternative to a sleeping bag, it's easy and comfortable to use inside your hammock and complements the DD Underblanket perfectly.

It has a three-quarter length opening on the underside for easy entry and exit when sleeping in a hammock, plus an integrated hood and foot covering. Drawstrings round the perimeter of the underside opening, the open foot end and the hood let you cinch the quilt in so it wraps around your whole body, which is ideal for keeping out an unexpected chilly breeze and holding on to warmth until sunrise.

If it warms up, or you want to spread out, just loosen the drawstrings and the quilt opens up again.

The DD Hammock Quilt offers its optimum comfort level in temperatures down to 2°C (35°F) when used with an Underblanket.

Whether you use a quilt or a sleeping bag for hammock camping is down to preference. If you'd like the extra option, consider our hammock-friendly Jura 2 Sleeping Bag, with its central zip and waterproof footbox.

Includes Hammock Quilt, compression sack

  • Three-quarter length opening on the underside for easy access
  • Drawcords on the underside opening, foot-end opening and around the hood to adjust the fit
  • Wider at the torso and narrower at the foot end, for a better fit: width at top 128cm, width at bottom 92cm, length 194cm

DD Camping Hammock: The Original, Simple and Lightweight

The DD Camping Hammock is DD's original hammock, enjoyed the world over by beginners and seasoned hammock campers alike. Strong and lightweight, it suits everything from lounging in the garden to wild camping.

It has two zip-open layers, so you can slide a partially inflated DD Inflatable Mat between them for extra insulation. You can use it on its own, add rain protection with a DD Tarp, and attach a DD Underblanket using the 4 tabs on the sides for extra warmth in the colder months.

DD Frontline Hammock in Jet Black: Built-In Mosquito Net

The popular DD Frontline Hammock is a versatile, tough, double-layered design with a breathable base and a mosquito net built in, so it excels in a wide range of climates.

Year-round comfort

With the webbing pre-fitted and 60cm spreader poles and elastic included to raise the net for a spacious interior, the Frontline is easy to set up and suits users with any level of hammock camping experience. Pair it with a DD Underblanket to camp in comfort during the colder months, or take it on a tropical expedition, as its netting and breathable material make it an ideal jungle hammock.

Sleep 100% bug-free with the insect net zipped up, or unzip both sides and roll the net up out of the way. You can also suspend the hammock with the net on the bottom to lounge out in the sun.

title: Trust Fire MC1 Rechargeable EDC Mini Flashlight
descriptionHtml:
TrustFire MC1 Rechargeable EDC Flashlight: Compact and Up to 1000 Lumens

The TrustFire MC1 packs a high-output rechargeable torch into a tiny 56mm x 20mm body that weighs just 44.5g. It's metal, with a textured body for superior grip, and has some clever, helpful features.

At the front is a Cree XP-L HI LED. Just behind it sit the magnetic charging port on one side and the on/off button on the other. Tap the button and a small LED shows the power level: green means 100-50%, yellow 50-20%, red 20-5%, and flashing red under 5%.

To switch on, press and hold the button until the light appears, then tap to change mode. Keep holding after it lights to reach strobe. The MC1 remembers the mode you left it on, so it comes back on in the same setting.

A double-sided clip lets you attach it to different items, pointing in different directions. The tail cap houses a magnet so you can stick the torch to metal when you're working on something. It comes with a rechargeable IMR16340 battery but also runs on a CR123A, and you reach the battery by undoing the tail cap.

In the box: the MC1, the battery, a magnetic charging cable, the clip, a lanyard, a replacement o-ring, a keyring ring and the manual.

Features

  • Metal construction
  • Magnetic charging
  • Tail cap magnet
  • Double-sided pocket clip
  • Runs off rechargeable IMR16340 battery (included) or CR123A battery
  • Power level light
  • IPX8 waterproof rating
  • 1.5m impact resistance
  • Cree XP-L HI LED
  • Lumens: 15 (low) / 168 (medium) / 1000 (high and strobe)
  • Beam distance: 12m (low) / 51m (medium) / 129m (high)
  • Run time: 54h (low) / 139min (medium) / 75min (high)
  • Size: 56mm x 20mm
  • Weight: 44.5g

Need a bigger beam? Take a look at the TrustFire Z9 Zoomable Flashlight. Browse more camping torches and TrustFire torches.

The TrustFire Z9 is built from anodised aluminium, delivers 600 lumens and can be zoomed for more direct light. The sturdy body will handle impacts and contact with abrasive surfaces, and at just 142g it's small and light enough to carry anywhere.

It's powered by a rechargeable 18650 battery (not included), which you can recharge with a micro USB cable (not included) plugged into the side of the torch. That means no lugging around spare batteries, and you can even recharge from a powerbank.

The zoom lets you focus the beam onto a smaller or wider area, making the Z9 ideal for fishing, camping, biking, hiking and other outdoor activities. Press the rubber tail cap to switch it on and cycle between high mode (600 lumens), low mode (230 lumens) and strobe.

Made from 190T polyester with a PU coating with a waterproof rating of 3,000mm, it'll keep everyone dry, no matter the conditions. Plus, the taped seams give you extra waterproofing, so you don't have to worry about any leakages.

Weighing only 1.9kg, it's a breeze to carry and easily packs down into its drawstring stuff sack. With a whopping 25 attachment points, it offers a wide range of tarp set-up options, keeping you protected no matter where you have to seek shelter from the elements.

Yes, the DD 5x5 Olive Green Tarp is suitable for wild camping. Its waterproof material and multiple attachment points provide reliable shelter in diverse environments, making it an excellent choice for wilderness adventures with larger groups.

Use the 25 attachment points to create your desired shape. Secure the tarp with pegs and guy lines at the corners and edges. Choose suitable anchor points, such as trees or poles, for added stability, ensuring the shelter is taut and strong.

With the webbing pre-fitted and wide 60cm spreader pole/elastic included to raise the net for a spacious interior space, the Travel Hammock is a versatile system suitable for users with any level of hammock camping experience.
Great on and off the ground
The DD Travel hammock's waterproof base makes it ready to deploy on the ground as a bivi. Backpackers and long-distance hikers will appreciate this, in the event that the next campsite turns out to be tree-free!
Zip up the net for 100% bug protection, or simply unzip both sides and roll up to secure out of the way. Alternatively, suspend the hammock with the net on the bottom to lounge out in the sun! The 4 storage pouches can be used on either the interior or exterior of the hammock, all you need to do is flip them to the outside when the hammock is used with the net on the bottom!
Please Note: 
The Travel Hammock is designed for dual use (on/off ground), and is not ideal solely for use as a hammock. If you're looking for a cross-season hammock, consider the DD Frontline Hammock- it is the same design, but with breathable base layers.
Some Travel Hammock users may experience mild condensation due to the waterproof floor. This can be down to the air flow into the hammock set-up or the sleeping temperature of the individual. To increase air flow, we recommend suspending your tarp higher up or in a 'diamond' formation.
Size 2.7m x 1.4m (comfortable for people up to 6ft 5in and 125kg)
Colour Olive green, Coyote brown
Weight 930g (hammock only)
Includes Travel Hammock, Webbing (10m), 2 x elastic cord, 2 x spreader poles, stuff sack
Weight limit 125 kg
  • Double-layered design with velcro tab closure – insert a partially-inflated thermarest between the layers in cooler weather
  • Waterproof floor layer for use on the ground
  • Ultra-fine mesh mosquito net built in: zips closed and protects against all insects (even the smallest!)
  • Foldable lightweight 60cm spreader poles and two 2m lengths of elastic, to suspend the net
  • 2 x double-sided zippers for easy open and close
  • 2 x internal hanging loops for torches, glasses etc.
  • 4 pouch pockets to store small valuables - can be used whilst the hammock is in any configuration.
  • 4 tabs on each corner of the base - to peg out, to suspend equipment from or to fit a DD Underblanket
  • Pre-fitted with 10m strong suspension webbing (5m each end)
  • Stuff sack

title: DD Nest Hammock - MC Multicamo
descriptionHtml:
The most camouflaged hammock yet!

The DD Nest Hammock is covered head-to-toe in our own DD Multicam pattern, designed to make sure you blend in perfectly to woodland environments. This hammock ensures the most covert campsite possible, whilst keeping all the time-tested comfort and features that a DD Hammock provides.

Fully featured for covert camping.

With a similar design to our highly-regarded Frontline Hammock, the Nest Hammock swaps the integrated mosquito net for a full DD Multicam top shield; offering a spacious shelter from wind and insects, as well as any prying eyes. A fine-mesh window at the head end of the hammock gives a good outward view without compromising the camo-capabilities!

Dual, breathable base layers keep things comfortable in warmer climates, whilst insulation such as a DD Inflatable Mat can be inserted between the layers in the chillier months.

The DD Nest Hammock comes with 10m of suspension webbing pre-fitted, whilst 4 internal pouch pockets allow for easy storage of essentials and valuables.

Want to lie in the open air? Just roll up the top shield and suspend it on the spreader poles above, or just remove the spreader poles entirely and flip the entire hammock over!

This hammock is not designed to be waterproof. However, the DD Nest Hammock's top shield will provide some windproofing, as well as protection against very light rain.

For full weatherproofing, we would recommend pairing this hammock with the DD Tarp 3x3 - MC
